Choose "System browser" under "Open links in" to opt out. In-app links show a browser icon, and links no longer open in two browsers.

  • #13804 9f739b0 - Support public HTTPS pages and public CDN resources in localhost previews with a high-resolution streamed Agent Manager browser. Explain missing browser installations and provide download, retry, and settings actions. Keep clipboard actions ordered, honor page clipboard handlers, and close stalled browser sessions without waiting on renderer input. Preserve native cross-origin request checks while blocking unowned browser pages.

  • #13808 430e6cf Thanks @sylwester-liljegren! - Add commands to close the current task or all visible task tabs.

  • #14540 277103f Thanks @vkeerthivikram! - Add a stop button to session cleanup: a running cleanup pass can now be stopped from the settings screen. Already-deleted sessions stay deleted, the interrupted pass records its partial result, and the session database reclaims the freed disk space.

VS Code

7.7.9

Minor Changes

  • #14444 f85f62c - Add Close to the Right to the Agent Manager tab menu. It closes the session, terminal, and review tabs that sit after the target tab and keeps pinned tabs open.

  • #14485 9088b7d - Install Marketplace plugins from a git repository. Plugin catalog entries can now use a git source such as git:github.com/owner/repo@v1.2.3#subdir, so a plugin can be distributed from a public repository without publishing to npm. The client clones the repository at the pinned ref into the plugin cache and loads the plugin from there.

  • #14281 7c59855 - Install plugins from the Kilo Marketplace. The Marketplace now lists plugin items alongside agents, skills, and MCP servers, and installing one adds the npm package to Kilo's plugin configuration for the chosen project or global scope. Removing a plugin item cleans the configuration entry again.

  • #14446 fccda25 - Add pinning and Close to the Right to the sidebar session tabs. Pinned tabs stay at the front and survive Close Others and Close to the Right.

VS Code

7.7.6

Minor Changes

  • #14054 3b6746c Thanks @vkeerthivikram! - Reintroduce automatic session cleanup in Settings > Checkpoints. Keep it off by default and apply the configured retention period across all projects and Kilo clients on the machine. Protect running sessions and sessions with a recent fork, confirm manual cleanup, and show live session-level progress with a spinner and processed, deleted, and failed counts. Avoid scanning unrelated session history and preserve progress when status updates are delayed.

  • #14301 f03ebe3 - Create new Git projects and clone repositories directly from Agent Manager. Choose where projects are stored and attach them without changing the VS Code workspace. Adding a project or cloning a repository that is already present opens the existing project instead of creating a duplicate, and a repository whose checkout failed can still be attached.

    Create empty, unsigned bootstrap commits without normal commit hooks, while preserving staged files and Git configuration.

  • #14282 d0475a6 - Label prompts that Kilo sends on your behalf, such as worktree updates from base, expanded slash commands, and editor or terminal code actions, with a "Sent by Kilo" header. Long prompts collapse to their first paragraph with a "Show prompt" toggle to inspect the full text, and reverting or editing a turn restores the command instead of the full template.

  • #14344 83d276a - Load older chats on demand in the session history with a "Load more" control instead of stopping at the 100 most recent. Paging works across the workspace and every worktree directory.

  • #14346 65702ab - Preview session display settings with an automatic sample conversation that streams reasoning, tool progress, and an answer beside the controls.

    Apply review-focused or compact display presets from settings, and use the same display defaults during onboarding.

  • #14292 8c724ef - Show a clock status on Agent Manager tabs and worktrees when a session is waiting for a scheduled wakeup.

Patch Changes

  • #13979 fbdbe11 Thanks @mardausdennis! - Pin Agent Manager session tabs. Right-click a session tab and choose Pin to move it to the front of the tab bar; pinned tabs keep that position across reloads, survive Close Others, and can be dragged among themselves. Unpin returns the tab to its normal spot.

  • #14349 1030bdb - Focus the Changes diff viewport when the diff shortcut opens it or its reading content is clicked, show its complete focus border only while it owns reading focus, and restore the previous prompt or opener when it closes. Keep delayed prompt recovery from stealing diff focus, release diff focus on outside clicks, and route paste from non-editable areas to the prompt. Scroll a page with Shift+ArrowDown or Shift+ArrowUp when the diff viewport itself has focus and no text is selected.

  • #14348 24898d5 - Stop session progress spinners when sessions finish in a background project, and recover their status after reconnecting.

  • #14333 74717ee Thanks @hdcodedev! - Fix the chat prompt sending the wrong text after a collapsed paste chip is deleted.

  • #14322 f47c29d Thanks @BambinoSK! - Remember the unified/split choice in Kilo diff viewers. Toggling the style once persists it for future diff viewers.

  • #14286 5bbad4c - Retry transient backend connection drops instead of surfacing a "terminated" error.

  • #14343 9d81d4a - Translate session cleanup progress and error messages in all supported languages.

Patch Changes

  • #13340 f3d6d09 Thanks @rakshith1928! - Fix auto-compaction triggering far below the configured context threshold. The threshold now applies to the context window shown in the UI and is anchored to provider-reported token usage plus newly added content, instead of an inflated estimate of the whole payload on models with separate input limits. New system prompts and tool schemas are counted even when a provider report is available, and cancelled responses or reports that omit input usage no longer leave later content uncounted. On models whose input limit is smaller than their context window, the reserved input safety buffer can still trigger compaction before a high configured percentage is reached.

  • #14351 a7d1596 Thanks @jezdez! - Support encrypted reasoning from OpenAI models accessed through Amazon Bedrock.

  • #14282 d0475a6 - Label prompts that Kilo sends on your behalf, such as worktree updates from base, expanded slash commands, and editor or terminal code actions, with a "Sent by Kilo" header. Long prompts collapse to their first paragraph with a "Show prompt" toggle to inspect the full text, and reverting or editing a turn restores the command instead of the full template.

The response is now reported as "no stream on this endpoint", which the MCP client treats as supported.

items.html:
VS Code

7.7.4

Minor Changes

  • #14233 b07646f - Open Mermaid diagrams in a fullscreen zoom viewer with zoom in/out, reset, mouse-wheel zoom, and drag-to-pan

  • #14255 4881829 - Leftover worktree folders now show a count and total size in the warning banner, with a "Resolve…" action that opens a dialog listing each folder's path, size, and whether it still holds a git checkout. While the total is still being measured the banner says so, and if the measurement fails it reports the count alone instead of claiming 0 B. Measuring stops as soon as you start a delete, or whenever the folder list changes, rather than walking folders that are on their way out, and then re-measures whatever is left. The dialog's explanation starts collapsed to its first paragraph behind a "Show more" link, and its checkboxes are drawn the way each IDE draws its own. Deletion runs in the background so the UI never freezes, folders that still contain a checkout are unchecked by default, and a completion notification reports how many were removed. Worktree deletion is also more thorough: JetBrains now tears down backend state and removes the snapshot repository for a deleted worktree the same way VS Code already does, and a directory that reappears immediately after deletion is cleaned up once more automatically.

Patch Changes

  • #14230 6b5e8a0 - Add an experimental Programmatic Tool Calling setting under Settings > Experimental. When enabled, the agent calls MCP tools from a confined JavaScript program and discovers tools on demand, so fewer MCP tool definitions are sent to the model. The KILO_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE environment variable still enables it.

  • #14231 7e0ce5e - Generate chat session titles after a turn provides enough context instead of from the first message alone. A short first message now keeps the placeholder title until the session has a longer request, a second message, or real tool work, so titles describe the actual task rather than a bare URL or a truncated first line.

  • #14225 88d2315 - Prevent failed status notifications from leaving completed sessions marked busy and blocking reload.

  • #14015 12b44cb Thanks @intentionally-left-nil! - Fix "missing x-opencode-session" errors from memory consolidation, prompt enhancement, and the roll-call diagnostic command when using an OpenCode-managed model.

VS Code

7.7.3

Major Changes

  • #14209 3eaf47b - Remove KiloClaw: the VS Code chat panel and sidebar button, the /kiloclaw TUI command and chat view, the Kilo Chat client and token handling, and the kilo.claw.status and kilo.claw.chatCredentials gateway endpoints.

Minor Changes

  • #14204 d202c80 - Animate the Kilo logo on the welcome screen: hover the mark to see it turn and play the yellow slot-machine animation.

  • #13519 9e61d68 - Show ChatGPT Codex quota alongside other provider usage in the CLI and VS Code.

  • #14170 36771e6 - Show large pasted text in the prompt input as an expandable [Pasted ~N lines] block that restores the full text when expanded, copied, or sent.

  • #14137 91040bc - Report worktree problems accurately and repair them: stale entries are cleaned up on their own, a deleted worktree can be restored from its branch or removed while keeping its sessions, leftover folders are listed with a cleanup action, and a failed status check now says so instead of showing a worktree as unchanged. Pull request lookups no longer stall on an unresponsive GitHub CLI, a single broken worktree no longer slows down the others, and deleting a worktree while its status is being checked no longer hides review and CI badges on every other worktree until the IDE restarts. The cleanup notice now marks leftover folders that still contain a git checkout and warns that they may hold uncommitted work, and removing a stale worktree entry no longer fails when its terminals cannot be stopped. New "Show Worktree Diagnostics" command in VS Code and "Copy report" action in JetBrains settings.

Patch Changes

  • #14200 78a4d93 - Fix Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z, and Ctrl+Y undo and redo in the chat input, including on non-Latin keyboard layouts

  • #14210 8437096 - Restrict chat search to user and assistant messages, so reasoning blocks, tool calls, and tool output no longer produce matches

  • #14185 b51f2e3 - Fix document previews reporting "Document is outside the worktree" for files inside the project when the path casing differs

  • #14206 634d1a7 - Make Agent Manager worktree deletion near-instant in large repositories: the directory is detached without waiting for other git operations, backend cleanup no longer boots an instance for the worktree, and checkpoint cleanup finishes in the background. A worktree whose conversations cannot be re-homed is still deleted instead of leaving an undeletable card.

  • #14199 98918cd - Render inline edit and write diffs in the chat with the same gutter bars, word highlighting, and colors as the diff viewer, and keep them mounted while the tool streams.

  • #14183 3a98691 - Reload the pull request diff after a review comment is rejected because its snapshot expired, so the comment can be posted again without reopening the review.

  • #14180 dd2f2f9 Thanks @WebReflection! - Keep model and reasoning choices when switching modes, and remember explicit new-session choices as the default without changing open sessions.

    • Keep an untouched draft on Default reasoning when selecting a different effort in another draft.
    • Keep the model and reasoning effort together when a mode-only command starts a new session.

  • #14208 1d187e8 - Remove the deprecated /local-review and /local-review-uncommitted command aliases. Use /review with its scopes instead.

  • #14049 c6936a7 - Restore built-in Playwright browser automation and its settings under Web Tools. Keep the experimental Integrated Browser independent and allow its panel to open before selecting a session.

  • #14142 68879be Thanks @mondalaci! - Restore chat prompt focus when returning to VS Code if the prompt was focused before the window was deactivated.

  • #14170 9be66de - Keep large review diffs from jumping when file rows are re-created at a different panel width.

  • #14201 5bf040e - Load skills from skills.paths entries written with a leading slash, such as /.github/skills, by falling back to the project root when no such directory exists at the filesystem root. Show skills in the VS Code slash menu under their own Skills group and list a skill that shares a name with a command as /name:skill.

  • #14203 96b2b16 - Keep the chat transcript steady while the agent works. A question prompt no longer disappears for a moment when it is answered, updates that arrive in the same frame now paint once, the view stays pinned to the bottom while a permission is pending or the composer grows, and expanded edit diffs no longer collapse and re-expand when they scroll back into view.

VS Code

  • #14159 0480c79 - Support a custom speech-to-text source. Point voice input at any OpenAI-compatible transcription API with a base URL and optional API key, instead of always using Kilo Gateway. Switching back to Kilo Gateway restores a valid Gateway transcription model instead of showing the custom one, and a custom endpoint requires its own model ID. Custom transcription settings are read from the global config only, so a workspace config cannot redirect voice input.

VS Code

7.7.1

Minor Changes

  • #14126 4fb9f38 - Copy a link to any PR review comment from the Agent Manager PR panel.

  • #14144 53a553f - Add a Reasoning Blocks display setting with Expanded, Preview, and Headline modes. Headline shows only the reasoning header and streaming indicator until you open the block, and your open or closed choice is kept while the response streams. Preview keeps a short capped scrolling preview while the agent writes and stays compact after it finishes, and blocks from earlier sessions start collapsed. Expanded keeps the full text open. The setting replaces Auto-Collapse Reasoning; existing auto_collapse_reasoning: true configurations map to Preview.

    Keep the Preview viewport anchored to the newest reasoning text after the block finishes, so later tool calls no longer make it jump back to the top.

    Background subagent transcripts use the same Reasoning Blocks setting instead of always showing the capped preview.

Patch Changes

  • #14127 7bbba88 - Fix "Close Others" in the Agent Manager leaving closed session tabs open in the local tab bar.

  • #14150 94c3e3c - Fix the Agent Manager sidebar going blank when a PR badge changes status

  • #14145 c1195f0 - Stop showing a merged or closed pull request of an old branch on an Agent Manager worktree that only reuses its branch name.

  • #14146 9701f12 - Keep the project row with its New worktree button pinned while scrolling the Agent Manager project list.

7.7.0

Minor Changes

  • #14102 81ecad2 - Mention sessions, worktrees, terminals, and open documents by dragging their tab or card into the prompt.

  • #14051 b30b2cf - Let permission denials include feedback so the agent can adjust before retrying.

    Keep saved approval rules unchanged unless explicitly selected, and show a clear message when an edit has no changes to review.

  • #14025 1ef46bd - Post inline comments to a checked-out GitHub pull request from Changes and Agent Manager diff views. The compact composer saves locally, sends to Kilo, or posts to GitHub with an explicit destination choice. Cmd/Ctrl+Enter saves a comment, and pressing it again in the review view sends all comments to Kilo without publishing to GitHub. The toolbar shows separate send-all-to-Kilo and send-all-to-GitHub actions, and only the Kilo action carries the keyboard shortcut. GitHub posting stops on the first error so unpublished comments are kept.

  • #14105 b06c745 - Disconnect built-in providers without disabling them, and let users change stored API keys directly for providers with standard API-key authentication.

    Keep settings saves available after disabling or enabling a provider.

  • #14134 50fc57d - Enable the Kilo Swarm shared board by default. Turn it off in Agent Behaviour settings or with experimental.shared_agent_board: false.

  • #14050 7a6ab9a - Speed up Agent Manager worktree creation by pre-warming reusable worktrees and claiming a ready one instead of running a full checkout. Control the pre-warming in Agent Manager settings under "Pre-warm worktrees"; it is enabled by default and uses one extra checkout of disk space per open project.

    Prepare snapshots during session creation to reduce first-prompt initialization work. Start no-script sessions after environment files are copied, while preserving setup-script completion before agent startup. Discarded worktrees now remove their checkpoint data instead of leaving it behind.

    Resolve the primary checkout with one git call instead of four and discover agents and skills for a new worktree before the first prompt arrives, so the first response starts sooner.

Patch Changes

  • #14104 3c040da - Keep background subagent task cards collapsed and show their reasoning as a compact preview instead of expanding while the agent runs.

  • #14116 81b9c21 - Reduce GitHub API usage of Agent Manager PR status polling by resolving all worktrees in one request per sync.

  • #14045 f64c664 - Move the compaction model setting to the Models settings tab and link to it from the Compaction section.

  • #14106 20c5742 - Close the @ mention menu when prose follows a typed or picked mention, keep it closed after Escape, and let Enter send the message instead of replacing the draft with a loose fuzzy match.

  • #14103 3a2c5d5 - Reload the entire project for /reload and the reload actions. A reload from an Agent Manager worktree now reboots every loaded instance of the same project, so a project config change applies to the main checkout and all worktrees. The reload is refused while any session in the project is running.

  • #14046 e49e786 - Keep the working indicator snug above the prompt at every sidebar width instead of floating in the empty space reserved for the wrapped session actions row.

  • #14115 f40394f - Start the first snapshot of a new worktree several times faster. Seeding now reuses the checkout's index state instead of re-hashing every file, snapshot preparation reconciles the working tree before the first prompt arrives, and repacking snapshot objects waits until the snapshot repository is idle instead of blocking the tool steps of the running turn.

    Delay the replacement of a claimed pre-warmed worktree so its checkout does not compete with the new session's first prompt.

7.6.0

Permission prompts still confirm each commit and push. Turn off "Push Pull Request Fixes" in Settings, Agent Behaviour to keep commits manual.

  • #13927 ed3cdc6 - Add the /caffeinate command and notifications that explain when Kilo keeps the computer awake while agents work.

  • #13929 9dae829 Thanks @WebReflection! - Add an opt-in, one-time import of supported global Claude Code instructions, simple skills, and disabled MCP definitions into Kilo.

  • #13965 6bbe6ac - Click the thinking indicator to scroll the current chat to the latest message.

  • #13903 99eab84 - Write and preview multiline PR comments and code suggestions, reply from the PR panel or diff view, and edit or delete your own comments directly in Agent Manager.

    Comment on selected PR diff lines, submit reviews, and preview and apply suggested changes to the local worktree without staging, committing, or pushing.

  • #13771 3c28e7a Thanks @sylwester-liljegren! - Alert you when Kilo finishes a task, needs your input, needs permission, or hits a terminal error. Enable VS Code notifications, native OS notifications (Windows, macOS, and Linux), or both — OS notifications reach you while the editor is in the background, and VS Code notifications wait for you with a Show action that opens the session and jumps to the latest message. Notifications are skipped for the session you are already looking at, they follow your selected language, and a Test button confirms native notifications work on your system.

  • #13958 4c2a6eb - Show commits, force pushes, merges, approvals, and the pull request description in the Agent Manager PR conversation, in the order they happened.

  • #13953 3c04a86 - Show pull request approvals and merge readiness in Agent Manager, with GitHub-backed branch updates, merge methods, auto-merge, and conflict resolution with Kilo.

  • #13679 e27ff0a - Keep working toward a session goal with /goal, with shared pause, resume, and clear controls in the terminal and VS Code. Pause goals after no-action replies, terminal failures, Stop, new messages, and backend restarts. Rename custom commands or MCP prompts named goal to use this reserved command. Show a labeled Goal icon with hover details while work runs.

    Compose multiline goals with images and file attachments in VS Code. Select /goal to enter goal mode, or cancel to keep the draft as ordinary chat. Keep drafts and attachments when submission fails.

    Keep the current goal running when replacement attachments are invalid. Make pending Goal submissions read-only, and preserve the draft when Cancel exits Goal mode before acknowledgement.

    Disable clarification questions during active goals and delegated work while keeping permission approvals unchanged. Make safe, reversible decisions autonomously and report completion or blockers.

    Retain Active, Complete, Blocked, and Paused goals with their objective and reason until explicitly cleared. Let the working model explicitly report completion or a blocker with the Goal-only reporting tool, without a separate evaluator or independent verification claim. Pause no-action turns that have no explicit report. Keep complete goals complete after a backend restart and label their resume action as Restart.

    Starting a Goal while a response is running replaces that response after the Goal request is validated.

  • #13940 b8fe009 - Identify subagents with consistent theme-colored avatars in Task cards, background agents, subagent tabs, and swarm messages. Show all participants in board message headers, and animate running avatars instead of showing a separate loading indicator.

  • #13782 4d2d800 - View and reset the shared agent board from its owning session without stopping agents or clearing conversations.

  • #13916 1ec6268 - Regroup the Agent Manager toolbar: optional session panels (documents, subagents) sit left of a separator, and the fixed workbench (changes, PR, apply, open in VS Code, browser, run, terminal) keeps stable positions on the right. Toolbar icons render at a uniform 1px stroke and dim when disabled. Open the full-screen review from the changes panel header instead of a toolbar button.

items.html:
Fixed

  • Restore CLI and TUI startup after v7.5.0 could open to a black screen on Windows and macOS.
  • Fix the Windows startup failure caused by Bun 1.4 raising EACCES while probing WindowsApps\pwsh.exe.
  • Restore the proven Bun 1.3.14 runtime and non-split compiled CLI configuration from v7.4.23.
  • Ship the corrected CLI in the npm package and all stable VS Code Marketplace and Open VSX platform builds.

This release supersedes v7.5.0.

Upgrade

npm install -g @kilocode/cli@latest
kilo --version

The reported version should be 7.5.4. VS Code installations receive the corrected extension through the normal stable update channel.

Validation

  • Built and validated all CLI release targets.
  • Passed artifact smoke tests on Windows x64/arm64, macOS x64/arm64, Linux x64/arm64, and Alpine x64/arm64.
  • Passed the end-to-end pre-publish agent smoke gate.

Fixes #13467 and #13473. Implemented in #13481.

7.4.22

Minor Changes

  • #11219 8013e5f Thanks @sylwester-liljegren! - Make file references in agent responses clickable by validating inline code spans against the filesystem. Code spans that match real files in the workspace become clickable links that open the file at the referenced line. Non-existent paths stay as plain code. Also adds fallback workspace search and "File not found" warning when clicking dead links.

  • #13071 3e3dd3d Thanks @cosi-conda! - Add Agent Manager PR comment actions: resolve/unresolve review threads, jump to comments section, and scroll-to-top for PR diff view.

  • #13063 ca9a99f - Show and select the model's default reasoning variant in chat and Agent Manager.

  • #13100 753d560 - Support structured AWS access keys and Google Cloud service-account JSON when connecting Bedrock and Vertex AI in VS Code.

  • #12373 3a99f36 Thanks @mvanhorn! - Fix subagent permission errors that referenced phantom deny rules and blocked commands the subagent's own config explicitly allowed. A read-only or delegating agent's readOnlyBash allowlist is no longer projected onto a writable subagent as a bash ceiling, so a delegated subagent can run its own allowed commands (e.g. git status). Edit, notebook, and MCP denials are still inherited as hard ceilings.

  • #13088 9f4ab3a - Keep the Changes chip and Git changes visible across tab switches in multi-repository workspaces.

  • Changes from opencode v1.17.13 to v1.18.0 upstream:

    • Core Improvements: Added a code mode MCP adapter for running confined orchestration scripts against connected MCP tools.
    • Core Improvements: Hid the execute tool unless code mode is enabled.
    • Core Improvements: Add a model-specific system prompt for Meta Muse Spark.
    • Core Improvements: Updated Azure AI support for GPT-5.6.
    • Core Bugfixes: Fixed paginated MCP tool catalogs losing tool metadata and output schema validation.
    • Core Bugfixes: Preserved low reasoning effort for OpenRouter small-model variants instead of disabling it.
    • Core Bugfixes: Fixed GitHub Copilot model routing to honor each model's advertised chat or responses endpoint.
    • Core Bugfixes: Fixed session lists to match equivalent instance directories reliably.
    • Core Bugfixes: Fixed Cerebras reasoning replay so earlier assistant reasoning is sent back in the provider-supported field.
    • Core Bugfixes: Better classify Z.ai context-window overflow errors so oversized requests surface the right failure mode (@fengjikui)
    • Core Bugfixes: Handle unavailable config directories more gracefully when reading config files
    • Core Bugfixes: Exposed reasoning effort variants for Grok models.
    • Core Bugfixes: Improved xAI prompt cache routing and PDF file support in Responses models.
    • Core Bugfixes: Improved Meta model handling for reasoning variants and provider requests.
    • Core Bugfixes: Prevent crashes and bad pricing data when GitHub Copilot returns models with a zero billing batch size.
    • Core Bugfixes: Supported OpenAI pro reasoning mode.
    • Core Bugfixes: Disabled response storage by default for xAI Responses. (@geraint0923)
    • Core Bugfixes: Added OAuth support for Luna Responses Lite.
    • Core Bugfixes: Switched to another available org after logging out in the console.
    • Core Bugfixes: Used Codex context limits for GPT-5.6 over OAuth. (@nabilfreeman)
    • Core Bugfixes: Removed an obsolete Codex workaround that could interfere with OpenAI Luna Responses Lite requests.
    • TUI Bugfixes: Fixed spinner registration so loading indicators keep rendering across TUI surfaces.
    • TUI Bugfixes: Forwarded CLI environment variables to the TUI worker.

  • Adopt upstream improvements from v1.18.1 through v1.18.13, including model compatibility, MCP reliability, and TUI enhancements.

  • #13104 9b01d97 - Preserve workspace restoration outcomes when reverting fresh VS Code sessions.

items.html:
7.4.18

Minor Changes

  • #12681 3ab1122 - Add a scope selector and base branch picker to the Agent Manager diff review. The side panel and full-screen review now let you switch between Branch, Staged, Unstaged, and Session scopes for the selected worktree, and the Branch scope's base branch can be overridden from a picker next to it. Branch stays the default, so existing review behavior is unchanged.

  • #12566 46b7e55 - Add an experimental multi-project foundation for Agent Manager behind the Multi-Project Agent Manager toggle in Kilo Settings > Experimental. A persistent project registry catalogs additional Git repositories across restarts while the current workspace repository stays the pinned default project, and all repository-bound services (state, worktrees, setup scripts, stale tracking, polling) are now owned by immutable per-project contexts that can be activated, expanded, and switched through new project protocol messages. Every expanded project runs its own git stats and PR pollers, so all visible project accordions show live data at the same time; switching projects keeps previously visited projects expanded and restores the exact worktree or session that was open there. Sessions created anywhere (sidebar, another window, the CLI) appear in the owning project's list immediately, and open tabs stay private to the project they were opened in. Single-project behavior is unchanged when the experiment is disabled.

  • #12709 5c140b1 - Make the Agent Manager diff review follow the sidebar selection instead of a single session. Switching session tabs inside a worktree no longer refetches the Branch, Staged, and Unstaged scopes, the Session scope now swaps to the active session's changes on tab switch, and the Local tab gains the Session scope so sessions running in the workspace can be reviewed on their own. The Session scope shows a notice when snapshots are disabled instead of a blank list, worktrees without an open session now still show their branch diff, and the Apply dialog lists the worktree's changes again.

  • #12680 49223b3 - Run Agent Manager project scripts in the terminal selected by the existing toolbar dropdown. Agent Manager panel uses the named side terminal, while VS Code terminal retains the integrated task flow.

  • #12424 d6380b2 Thanks @bsflasher! - Add Persian (Farsi) as a UI language, including right-to-left layout. Contributed by Babak Safabahar.

  • #12606 286b672 Thanks @bagatao-anaconda! - Show skill shell commands in the permission prompt. When a skill runs embedded shell commands, the approval dialog now lists every command with Allow / Reject.

  • #12703 5076b62 - Run Agent Manager worktree setup scripts in the terminal selected by the toolbar dropdown. Agent Manager panel shows live setup output in a named Setup side tab that reveals itself while provisioning and hides again on success unless you engaged with the panel, while VS Code terminal retains the integrated task flow.

Patch Changes

  • #12696 a2b22d0 - Apply the Agent Manager base branch picker selection to the active diff immediately. Changing the base branch now refreshes the diff against the new base instead of keeping the previous comparison until the scope or session changed.

  • #12720 57a9a60 - Fix Agent Manager embedded terminals not opening in the side panel or as a tab.

  • #12691 301c14e - Make Cmd/Ctrl+/ toggle the Agent Manager terminal even when the webview keybinding forwarding drops the key while the prompt input is focused, and stop it from triggering the Agent Manager terminal while the Kilo sidebar is focused.

  • #12694 af6bb00 - Match the Agent Manager terminal shortcut fallback to the platform modifier (Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere) and consume the extension echo once per keypress so unrelated invocations are no longer swallowed.

  • #12722 5678c09 - Fix the Agent Manager detail pane blanking when an unassigned session is selected. Clicking a session that belongs to no worktree now renders the chat and read-only banner again instead of an empty content area, and live terminal tabs stay mounted across the switch.

  • #12658 dbcd582 - Keep the Agent Manager terminal cursor visible on the bottom row.

  • #12369 44f1373 - Allow users to enable web search for models from all providers through Kilo configuration, VS Code settings, and Kilo Console settings.

  • #12624 af4cb42 Thanks @Hardik180704! - Persist MCP server enable and disable changes from VS Code settings across window reloads.

  • #12656 f0d2c8f - Navigate long conversations from a compact prompt rail that loads earlier history as you scroll.

  • #12692 faf0236 - Fix the @ "Past chats" picker in Agent Manager showing only the current session's directory. It now lists previous sessions across the whole worktree family — the local workspace and every Agent Manager worktree — each labeled with its worktree name, matching the Agent Manager session search. Any listed session can be attached as context, including chats from other worktrees of the same repository.

items.html:
7.4.17

Minor Changes

  • #12631 3321216 - Show the ⌘1-9 (Ctrl+1-9 on Windows/Linux) shortcut badges on every Agent Manager sidebar card while the modifier key is held, making it easy to see which number jumps to which worktree before pressing it.

  • #12598 c6711fc - Let users open Agent Manager terminals in the VS Code terminal or an embedded side panel. The terminal button's dropdown picks the destination; the side panel shares the right-hand inspector with the diff view and keeps running in the background when hidden.

  • #12633 23039c0 - Support multiple Agent Manager side-panel terminals per context. The panel header is now a tab strip that reuses the main tab bar's terminal tabs: click to switch, drag to reorder, X to close a single terminal, and + to open another one. Terminal numbers fill gaps left by closed terminals, and tabs pick up the live title from the shell or running program (OSC escape codes), so a dev server or build names its own tab.

  • #12632 0d853df - Add a prompt navigator rail to the chat transcript. A thin rail of ticks on the left edge shows one tick per prompt you sent; hovering or focusing it expands a card listing those prompts with a short preview of the answer, and clicking jumps the transcript to that turn. It appears in the sidebar, Kilo editor tabs, the sub-agent viewer, and Agent Manager, and never changes the readable width of the chat.

Patch Changes

  • #12629 0a1c140 - Keep each Agent Manager panel's terminal destination consistent. A dropdown pick is now remembered per panel and no longer flips when another window rewrites the shared terminal destination setting, so the terminal shortcut keeps opening the terminal type that panel is actually using. The shortcut also no longer dead-ends on worktrees without an active session, and terminals left over from a reloaded webview are cleaned up instead of leaking.

  • #12587 16f8e7e - Keep conversations and workspace files unchanged when a checkpoint cannot be fully restored.

  • #12333 290a5af Thanks @IamCoder18! - Include basic-auth credentials in the Local and Network Console URLs printed by kilo console, so users on headless hosts (no DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY, SSH sessions, CI runners) can open the URL in a browser on another machine and reach the Console.

  • #12630 a7f972f - Open Agent Manager terminals faster and avoid delayed shell prompts.

  • #12560 65c5e9d - Update the visible agent mode when cycling modes in Kilo sidebars and pending session tabs.

  • #12561 44f5963 - Fix settings changes sometimes failing to save and apply in VS Code.

  • #12540 2da8949 Thanks @Githubguy132010! - Preserve parenthesized tilde expressions as literal text in rendered chat messages.

  • #12591 625d2b9 - Show prompt input toggle tooltips instantly on hover instead of after a delay.

  • #12460 51d8031 - Changes from opencode v1.17.5 to v1.17.9 upstream:

    • Core Bugfixes: Improved MCP server compatibility by declaring Kilo's supported client capabilities.
    • Core Bugfixes: Plugin client requests now reuse the active server instead of assuming the default local port.
    • Core Bugfixes: ACP shell tool calls now show the command and working directory from the start.
    • Core Bugfixes: Plugin-provided shell environment variables now apply to PTY sessions.
    • Core Bugfixes: OpenAI-compatible providers now accept MCP tool schemas that previously failed validation. (@jquense)
    • Core Bugfixes: Cloudflare AI Gateway now receives the configured API key correctly. (@keefetang)
    • Core Bugfixes: MCP tools without declared schema properties now work with providers that expect object properties.
    • Core Bugfixes: Long-running MCP tools now keep their timeout alive when they report progress. (@Nomadcxx)
    • Core Bugfixes: The MCP OAuth callback server now shuts down once authorization finishes or is cancelled.
    • Core Bugfixes: MCP tool failures now surface the server's error text instead of a generic failure.
    • Core Bugfixes: MCP OAuth error pages now escape provider error text correctly.
    • Core Bugfixes: Honor configured agent step limits by forcing a final text response instead of failing mid-run.
    • Core Bugfixes: Queue steering prompts before dismissing pending questions so the previous turn cannot resume first.
    • Core Bugfixes: Prevent local server credentials from leaking into spawned PTY processes.
    • Core Bugfixes: Fix Devstral model detection when provider IDs use different casing. (@Robin1987China)
    • Core Bugfixes: Pass configured custom headers to Copilot model requests.
    • Core Improvements: MCP servers can now receive the current workspace as a client root.
    • Core Improvements: Session timelines load much faster and avoid flicker or scroll jumps.
    • Core Improvements: Add high and max thinking variants for GLM-5.2 across supported providers. (@imranshaiedi-byte)
    • Core Improvements: Stop wrapping follow-up user messages in a steering reminder so prompt caching stays effective.
    • TUI Bugfixes: MCP debug now uses the SDK's latest protocol version.
    • TUI Bugfixes: Only show the background subagent shortcut when the server supports it.
    • UI Bugfixes: Render completed Mermaid blocks from diagram source instead of fenced Markdown.

  • #12401 210a6bb - Fix double scrollbars in the Agent Manager new-worktree prompt field and widen the dialog so longer prompts stay readable. The prompt box now grows with its content like the sidebar chat input, the textarea is the only element that scrolls, and manual resize of the prompt area keeps working.

items.html:
🪿 Goose v1.30.0 Release Notes

Released: April 8, 2026

✨ New Features

🖥️ Terminal UI (TUI) Overhaul
  • Tab-expandable tool calls — tool call output now collapses cleanly with tab to expand (#8136)
  • Improved message rendering — better ordering, streaming/scrolling, and overall visual polish for messages, tool calls, and text entry (#8144, #8156, #8214)
  • Independent --text mode — text mode is now decoupled from the normal TUI for a cleaner headless experience (#8210)
  • goose serve — new subcommand to run Goose as a background service (#8209)
🔌 Providers & Models
  • Gemini OAuth provider — first-class OAuth-based authentication for Google Gemini (#8129)
  • Copilot ACP provider — new provider for GitHub Copilot via ACP (#8154)
  • Zhipu declarative provider — adds Zhipu AI with configurable ZHIPU_BASE_URL override (#8204)
  • Configurable fast_model for declarative providers — lets you specify a lightweight model for quick tasks (#8194)
  • Gemma 4 local model support — enable Gemma 4 as a local model option (#8366)
  • VMware Tanzu Platform provider improvements — bug fixes, streaming support, and UI enhancements (#8126)
🛡️ Security & Observability
  • Egress logging inspector — new security feature to log and inspect outbound network calls (#8149)
  • Restricted secrets file permissions — secrets files are now created with tighter OS-level permissions (#8118)
🧩 Extensions & Skills
  • Show installed skills in UI — skills are now visible and browsable from the desktop app (#7910)
  • Skills platform extension — skills are now managed as a dedicated platform extension (#8377)
  • Recursively discover nested skills — skills under configured roots are now found at any depth (#8082)
  • Configurable extension timeouts — set timeouts per-extension via ACP _meta or a global default (#8295)
  • Reusable ACP provider controls — shared UI components for ACP provider configuration (#8314)
  • Rust ACP client for extension methods (#8227)
  • Developer MCP server enhancements (#7770)
🌐 Internationalization
  • i18n infrastructure — added react-intl based internationalization framework to the desktop app (#8105)
🩺 Diagnostics
  • goose doctor — new command to diagnose common configuration and environment issues (#8342)
⚙️ Configuration
  • GOOSE_SHOW_FULL_OUTPUT — new config option to disable tool output truncation (#7919)
  • GOOSE_CLI_SHOW_THINKING — can now be set in config.yaml (not just env vars) (#8097)
  • GOOSE_CONTEXT_LIMIT — now readable from config.yaml (#7900)
  • GOOSE_DISABLE_KEYRING — now honoured from config.yaml at startup (#8219)
  • Per-delegate max_turns override (#8066)
  • skip_canonical_filtering for declarative providers (#8052)
🏗️ Build & Packaging
  • Optional native-tls support — alternative to rustls for environments that need system TLS (#8037)
  • Feature-gated AWS provider dependencies — behind aws-providers feature flag for leaner builds (#8080)
  • Feature-gated telemetry — telemetry is now behind Cargo feature flags (#8119)

items.html:
本版新增项目栏「最近」跨项目找会话、每日定时深色模式和可关闭的输入框提示，并修复从旧版找回会话全部被跳过、更新失败后无法下载完整安装包等多处问题。

新增

  • 项目栏新增「最近」：按最近活动时间跨项目列出会话，完整分页、可搜索；点选后定位到所属项目并打开会话，也可选择远程环境。关联 #14319 fixed in #14784 by @lancy69。
  • 「外观 → 明暗」新增「定时」模式：每天按本机时间切换深色，默认 20:00 到次日 07:00，可跨午夜；桌面窗口的边框和底色同步变化。只有选择它时才生效。关联 #14699 fixed in #14783 by @lancy69。
  • 「外观 → 会话显示」新增「输入框提示」开关：可隐藏输入框里的任务和排队占位文字，默认显示，只保存在本机。关联 #14759 fixed in #14781 by @lancy69。
  • 文档：使用指南新增跨项目任务派发的完整流程。关联 #14603 fixed in #14780 by @lancy69。

变更

  • 浏览器工具的说明现在提示模型读静态网页时用 web_fetch、用完关闭标签，避免一轮留下十几个页面。修复 #14737 fixed in #14764。
  • 设置里「快捷键」页的卡片顺序调整：「Esc 停止任务」紧跟发送相关设置，全局快捷键和按键表放在后面。关联 #14789 fixed in #14790。

修复

  • 从旧版找回会话时，目标文件夹里残留没有对话文件的过期索引，会让所有会话被反复跳过、一个都导入不了；现在会清掉它们并正常导入，侧栏里的未导入列表也能显示。修复 #14804 fixed in #14806。
  • 更新失败后提示里的「下载完整安装包」改为用系统浏览器打开发布页，不再落到被设置页盖住的内置浏览器里。修复 #14775 fixed in #14788。
  • 侧栏里「早先版本」和「恢复副本」那一行，悬停或键盘聚焦时重新显示删除按钮 ×。修复 #14703 fixed in #14803 by @xxoingr。
  • 删除配置来源文件夹后，仍可移除残留的 MCP 服务；配置损坏时会保留服务，并指出无法解析的配置文件。关联 #14738 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69、#14739 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69。
  • 连接远程主机（如 WSL）时，读取会话列表、删除、置顶或归档不再每次都重新建立连接；连接在最后一次操作后保留 45 秒。修复 #14745 fixed in #14763。
  • 从对话分叉出的分支会继承源会话的上下文压缩简报，打开后继续在压缩视图上工作。关联 #14768 by @jf200s。
  • 同一项目里并行启动的隔离任务不再偶尔因 Git 报 failed to read …/commondir 而失败。关联 #14805 by @xxoingr。
  • 隔离结果应用、委派续跑和用量预算：应用时拒绝被换成目录链接的父目录，并发续跑不再重复创建转录副本，已知用量计入根预算，恢复任务时文件权限变化也会使旧证明失效。关联 #14025。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@lancy69、@xxoingr、@jf200s

New

  • The project header gains "Recent": conversations across projects by last activity, paged and searchable; picking one locates its project and opens it, also on remote hosts. Refs #14319 fixed in #14784 by @lancy69.
  • Appearance → Light and dark gains a "Scheduled" mode: dark during a daily local-clock range (default 20:00–07:00, overnight allowed); the window frame follows. Opt-in. Refs #14699 fixed in #14783 by @lancy69.
  • Appearance → Conversation display gains a "Composer hint" switch that hides the task and queue placeholder text; on by default, remembered on this machine. Refs #14759 fixed in #14781 by @lancy69.
  • Docs: the guide now walks through cross-project task dispatch. Refs #14603 fixed in #14780 by @lancy69.

Changed

  • The browser tool now tells the model to read static pages with web_fetch and to close tabs when done, so a turn no longer leaves a dozen pages open. Fixes #14737 fixed in #14764.
  • On the Shortcuts settings page, "Esc to stop" now sits right after the send settings, with the global shortcut and the key table after it. Refs #14789 fixed in #14790.

Fixed

  • Recovering older sessions no longer skips every conversation because of stale indexes with no transcript in the destination; they are cleared and the import proceeds. Fixes #14804 fixed in #14806.
  • After a failed update, "download the full installer" opens the release page in the system browser instead of the in-app browser behind the settings sheet. Fixes #14775 fixed in #14788.
  • An earlier version or recovery copy in the sidebar shows its delete × again on hover or keyboard focus. Fixes #14703 fixed in #14803 by @xxoingr.
  • Stale MCP servers can be removed after their source folder is deleted; a malformed config names the file and keeps the servers. Refs #14738 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69, #14739 fixed in #14749 by @lancy69.
  • On a remote host such as WSL, listing, deleting, pinning or archiving sessions no longer reconnects every time; the link is held 45 seconds after the last action. Fixes #14745 fixed in #14763.
  • A fork inherits its source's compacted context, so the branch continues on the compacted view. Refs #14768 by @jf200s.
  • Isolated tasks started in parallel in one project no longer fail now and then with Git's "failed to read …/commondir". Refs #14805 by @xxoingr.
  • Isolated results and delegation: applying refuses a parent directory swapped for a link, parallel continuations no longer duplicate copies, and known usage counts toward budgets. Refs #14025.

Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @lancy69, @xxoingr, @jf200s

What's Changed

  • fix(delegation): reserve ancestor copy admission / 预留祖先副本续跑准入 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14684
  • fix(agent): count reported totals in token budgets / 将已报告总量计入 token 预算 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14730
  • feat(e2ebench): a batch emits an auditable manifest by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14757
  • fix(agent): invalidate carried proof after file-mode changes / 文件模式变化时拒绝旧证明 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14677
  • feat(studio): show green unread markers instead of session dates by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14746
  • feat(studio): optional progress track for collapsed plans by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14747
  • fix(serve): hold a request's remote link past its answer by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14763
  • fix(tools): tell the model browser_open is visible and web_fetch reads static pages by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14764
  • feat(studio): choose steer or follow-up as the running-message default by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14750
  • fix(control): remove stale MCP entries without losing source authority by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14749
  • fix(control): a fork inherits its source's context projection by @jf200s in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14768
  • feat(control): support precise @path:start-end file references by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14748
  • fix(worktree): guard apply ancestors and confine deletions / 防止父目录链接重定向隔离结果删除 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14726
  • test(stats): every aggregate field declares its provenance by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14769
  • fix(control): bound the fallback recovery task summary by runes by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14773
  • fix(worktree): cut git stderr in error messages on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14774
  • docs: explain cross-project task dispatch by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14780
  • fix(studio): the full-installer link after a failed update opens the system browser by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14788
  • fix(studio): Esc-to-stop sits with the send settings on the Shortcuts page by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14790
  • test(desktop): the settings search is measured without the storage tally by @1012905 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14791
  • feat(serve): 通过 POST /tree/sessions/remove-many 批量删除会话 by @1012905 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14771

items.html:
本版新增可自定义的对话宽度百分比，调整设置页与安装升级的体验，并修复 Windows 沙箱下 Git Bash 不可用等多处问题。

新增

  • 「外观 → 尺寸 → 行宽」新增自定义百分比，可在 30–100% 之间按 1% 调整，对话与输入框一起生效，不影响已有预设。关联 #14649 fixed in #14667 by @lancy69。

变更

  • 设置页顶部的标题块（分类名、设置项数量）去掉了，导航已标明位置，第一张卡片直接出现在页面顶部。关联 #14625。
  • 已安装的程序位于项目文件夹内时，「用其他程序打开」会列出它并标明原因，悬停可看是哪个文件夹，不再悄悄消失。关联 #14627。
  • 安装升级时 Studio 还在运行，安装程序会连同内核一起关掉，必要时请求一次管理员权限；仍关不掉就用中文说明怎么退出。修复 #14658 fixed in #14659。
  • 设置里的「图形渲染」从「外观与主题」页移到「窗口与性能」页，和其他与占用相关的选项放在一起。修复 #14719 fixed in #14732。
  • 普通目录会话不再显示顶部的「原目录」徽标，独立工作树统一显示「独立工作树」并补充目录说明。关联 #14619 by @SivanCola。

修复

  • Windows 开启沙箱后 Git Bash 每条命令都报「couldn't create signal pipe」；现在 Git Bash 在沙箱下起不来时，会话自动改用 PowerShell 并说明原因。修复 #14713 fixed in #14735，关联 #14714。
  • 设置里主按钮（编辑模型后的「保存」、「新建预设」、「加入 QQ 群」）的文字与底色几乎同色、看不清的问题。修复 #14679 fixed in #14733。
  • 输入框下方的执行权限、模式、模型、强度菜单展开时，不再被上方的计划条盖住一截。修复 #14720 fixed in #14731。
  • 对话里「执行过程」一行的字号与同级的「思考」一行统一。修复 #14682 fixed in #14686。
  • 设置按钮高度对齐、重命名对话框字体统一，项目栏的「添加项目」在长列表滚动时保持可点。关联 #14600 fixed in #14708 by @lancy69、#14601 fixed in #14707 by @lancy69、#14607 fixed in #14709 by @lancy69。
  • 恢复会话时，纯图片的一轮不再消失，终端会显示「附有 N 张图片」。关联 #14716 by @chuiwenwei。
  • reasonix doctor catalogs 不再对记录过失败的目录打印 ok，而是显示 failed 或 degraded。关联 #14549 by @chuiwenwei。
  • 会话租约无法证明时不再谎称被占用：密钥擦除拒绝改写并以错误退出，会话与任务列表显示 unknown。关联 #14727 by @chuiwenwei。
  • 以 .. 开头的根目录名现在按仓库内路径判断 gitignore。关联 #14734 by @kevin9327。
  • 后台子任务的用量保留启动时的 Goal 归属，嵌套委派继承原归属；子任务恢复拒绝无法识别的持久化状态。关联 #14025。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@lancy69、@SivanCola、@chuiwenwei、@kevin9327

New

  • Appearance → Size → Line width has a custom percentage, 30–100% in 1% steps, applied to the transcript and composer together; the presets are unchanged. Refs #14649 fixed in #14667 by @lancy69.

Changed

  • The title block at the top of each settings page (section name and setting count) is gone; the navigation already shows where you are. Refs #14625.
  • An installed program inside a project folder is listed in "Open with" as unavailable, with the reason and folder on hover, instead of silently missing. Refs #14627.
  • During install or upgrade the installer closes a running Studio with its kernel, asks once for administrator permission if needed, and says how to quit by hand. Fixes #14658 fixed in #14659.
  • "Graphics rendering" moves from the Appearance and theme page to the Window and performance page, next to the other options that affect resource use. Fixes #14719 fixed in #14732.
  • Ordinary sessions no longer show the Local checkout header badge; isolated worktrees use one neutral label with explanatory tooltips. Refs #14619 by @SivanCola.

Fixed

  • With the Windows sandbox on, every Git Bash command failed; a sandboxed session now uses PowerShell and says why when Git Bash cannot start there. Fixes #14713 fixed in #14735, refs #14714.
  • Primary buttons in Settings (Save after editing a model, New preset, Join the QQ group) no longer draw their label in almost the same colour as their fill. Fixes #14679 fixed in #14733.
  • The permission, mode, model and effort menus under the composer are no longer partly covered by the plan bar above them. Fixes #14720 fixed in #14731.
  • The "Execution" row in a conversation uses the same text size as the "Thinking" row at the same level. Fixes #14682 fixed in #14686.
  • Settings button heights line up, the rename dialog uses the shared type styles, and the project header's Add project stays reachable while a long list scrolls. Refs #14600 fixed in #14708 by @lancy69, #14601 fixed in #14707 by @lancy69, #14607 fixed in #14709 by @lancy69.
  • A restored transcript no longer drops a turn that was only an image; the terminal says "N image(s) attached". Refs #14716 by @chuiwenwei.
  • reasonix doctor catalogs no longer prints ok for a catalog that recorded a failure; it reports failed or degraded. Refs #14549 by @chuiwenwei.
  • When a session lease cannot be proven, the secret scrub refuses to rewrite and exits non-zero instead of claiming the lease is held; listings show unknown. Refs #14727 by @chuiwenwei.
  • A root name starting with .. is judged as inside the repository for gitignore. Refs #14734 by @kevin9327.
  • Background children keep the Goal that started them for usage accounting, nested delegation inherits it, and subagent continuation refuses unrecognised persisted states. Refs #14025.

Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @lancy69, @SivanCola, @chuiwenwei, @kevin9327

What's Changed

  • feat(installer): close a running Studio thoroughly and say how when it cannot by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14659
  • fix(doctor): a catalog that recorded a failure is not ok by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14549
  • feat(proc): expose root wait completion / 区分根等待完成与取消返回 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14459
  • feat(mutation): coordinate opaque writes across roots / 未知范围写入跨根互斥 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14446
  • feat(isolation): prepare Store-owned candidates / 由结果 Store 统一准备候选 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14494
  • fix(studio): clarify worktree labels and directory choices / 简化工作树标识并保留目录模式选择 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14619
  • fix(deps): bump golang.org/x/net to v0.62.0 for GO-2026-6860 by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14685
  • feat(openwith): say why an installed program is not offered by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14654
  • feat(studio): add adjustable conversation viewport width by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14667
  • fix: retain delegated Goal usage ownership / 保留委派任务的 Goal 用量归属 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14661
  • fix(delegation): refuse unknown saved run states / 拒绝未知子任务恢复状态 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14656
  • fix(studio): the Execution row uses the same text size as the Thinking row by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14686
  • feat(desktop): drop the title block above each settings page by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14700
  • fix(studio): composer menus open above the plan bar by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14731
  • feat(studio): graphics rendering lives on the window and performance page by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14732
  • fix(studio): align settings header button heights by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14707
  • fix(studio): keep project controls outside the scrolling tree by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14708
  • fix(studio): use semantic typography in session rename dialog by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14709

items.html:
本版新增全局显示 / 隐藏快捷键、用量页的上传量、隐藏服务商共同前缀，并把设置拆成子页、壁纸移到外观，修复多处预算与界面问题。

新增

  • 桌面设置提供默认关闭的全局显示 / 隐藏快捷键，支持按键录制与清除；仅 Studio 运行时有效，不会启动已退出的应用。关联 #8290 fixed in #14592 by @lancy69。
  • 服务商设置里可以「隐藏共同前缀」，路由类服务给每个模型加的同一段前缀（如 group/）在各处显示时省略，只改显示。关联 #14573 fixed in #14578。
  • 设置 → 用量里多了「上传量」，显示今天和近 30 天发给模型服务商的请求内容大小、次数、平均每次多大，并按服务商列出。关联 #14670。
  • 反馈窗口会记住上一次成功提交的联系方式并自动填入，仍可修改，清空后不会再冒出旧的。关联 #14610 fixed in #14666 by @lancy69。
  • 主题可以按深色 / 浅色分别设置导航、图标栏、顶栏、侧栏和输入框在背景图上的不透明度。关联 #14589 by @lancy69。
  • 新增默认关闭的「连接检测」授权开关，只有你打开后才会向服务商发起后台检测请求。关联 #14620 by @SivanCola。

变更

  • 设置里「模型偏好」的「看图」下拉框只列出已声明支持读图的模型；已选的旧模型仍会显示，并标明"未声明读图"。关联 #14418 fixed in #14420 and #14597。
  • 「壁纸」及其选择、替换、移除、导入、浓度、压暗和焦点控件移到「外观」的独立区块，已选壁纸的预览直接显示。关联 #14470 fixed in #14588 by @lancy69。
  • 待发送队列与输入框共用外框和底色，采用紧凑透明行与轻量图标操作；现有操作与快捷键保持不变。关联 #14497 fixed in #14591 by @lancy69。
  • 较长的「工具与权限」和「外观」拆成几个子页，在左侧导航里直接点选；搜索或链接会自动切到设置所在的子页。关联 #14625。
  • 设置页文字统一成同一套样式，字号从 10 种减到 5 种，字重和灰色也收成固定几档。关联 #14625。
  • 关闭工作台里最后一个页面后，留下"新建页面"的启动器，不再把整列收起。关联 #14037 by @imcreazy。
  • 「柔和」对比度改为真正更低对比、仍达 AA 的内置配色，不再比默认更强。关联 #12019 fixed in #14590 by @lancy69。

修复

  • 打开设置时不再每次遍历磁盘统计「存储」大小；这个数字延后读取，十分钟内沿用上次结果。关联 #14315 fixed in #14650。
  • 用量总额会说明其中有几笔调用未定价、以及原因，不再只由一个标志暗示。关联 #14522 by @chuiwenwei。
  • 压缩上下文时摘要请求的连接被中途重置（比如本地网关重启），会自动重试一次，不再直接失败。关联 #14643 fixed in #14648。
  • 压缩后“较早的消息过长，只通过摘要保留”的提示在中文界面下也用中文显示。修复 #14651 fixed in #14664。
  • 命令或同一批调用被宿主拦截时，工具卡片用中文说明原因，不再显示英文的 blocked 提示。修复 #14652 fixed in #14655。
  • 历史超过读取上限的会话不再只报英文错误，会说明文件完好，并可「从最近的内容继续」另存为新会话。修复 #14660 fixed in #14662。
  • 删除来自 Reasonix 1.x 的会话后，同一会话不再重新出现在侧栏；删除状态重启后保留，且不修改 1.x 的原始存储。修复 #14632 fixed in #14657 by @lancy69。
  • 在弹窗里放大查看截图时，按 Esc 只退出大图，不再关掉整个反馈弹窗。修复 #14609 fixed in #14612。
  • 点“继续派发”后，输入框上方“待发送已暂停”的提示会随之消失。修复 #14616 fixed in #14618。
  • 鼠标点开设置等弹窗后按 Esc 关闭，左侧图标栏按钮不再带着焦点环停在“悬停”样子。关联 #14624。
  • 工作区里有多个 Git 仓库时，改动列表不再撑出面板，有自己的滚动条。修复 #14628 fixed in #14630。
  • 文件工具栏的保存按钮保持紧凑，启用和禁用状态都清晰可读。关联 #14231。
  • 同一个网关拒绝 stream_options 的结论按进程只学一次，不再让每个新会话都多发一次失败请求。关联 #14606。
  • 显式子代理技能调用遵守已有任务根预算；恢复 Goal 时规划与执行一起获得新的预算切片；本地费用门禁采用发生时刻的权威报价；Windows 跟踪命令保留已发布的 Job Object owner。关联 #14025。
  • 文件大小和修改时间未变时，候选快照不再复用 Git 缓存中的旧内容，私有索引重建保留用户暂存区。关联 #14025。
  • ACP 的 inbox 拒绝带机器码：-32020 队列拒绝，-32021 该工作可能已执行、不要重试。关联 #14551 by @chuiwenwei。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@lancy69、@SivanCola、@imcreazy、@chuiwenwei

New

  • An opt-in global show/hide shortcut in desktop settings, with key recording and Clear; it works only while Studio runs and never launches a stopped app. Refs #8290 fixed in #14592 by @lancy69.
  • A provider can hide the prefix all its models share (such as group/ from a router) everywhere the model name is drawn; display only. Refs #14573 fixed in #14578.
  • Settings → Usage has "Upload volume": request bodies sent to model providers today and over 30 days, count, average size, and a per-provider list. Refs #14670.
  • The feedback form remembers the last successfully submitted contact and prefills it; it stays editable and a cleared field stays cleared. Refs #14610 fixed in #14666 by @lancy69.
  • Themes can set per-scheme (dark / light) opacity for the navigation, rail, chrome, side and composer surfaces over a background image. Refs #14589 by @lancy69.
  • A default-off connection-health consent setting: background provider checks run only after you turn it on. Refs #14620 by @SivanCola.

Changed

  • The vision row in Model preferences lists only models declared to read images; a model chosen earlier stays visible, marked as not declared. Refs #14418 fixed in #14420 and #14597.
  • Wallpaper, choose/change/remove, import, strength, dim and focus move to Appearance; the selected preview is visible directly. Refs #14470 fixed in #14588 by @lancy69.
  • Pending messages share the composer frame, with compact transparent rows and icon actions; existing queue actions and shortcuts are unchanged. Refs #14497 fixed in #14591 by @lancy69.
  • The long Tools & permissions and Appearance sections are split into pages in the left navigation; search and links open the page a setting is on. Refs #14625.
  • Settings text follows one set of styles: 5 font sizes instead of 10, with fixed weights and grey tones. Refs #14625.
  • Closing the last page in the workbench leaves the new-page launcher instead of folding the column away. Refs #14037 by @imcreazy.
  • The Soft contrast level is a genuinely lower-contrast built-in palette that still meets AA, instead of reading stronger than the default. Refs #12019 fixed in #14590 by @lancy69.

Fixed

  • Opening Settings no longer walks the disk for the Storage total each time; it is read after the window is up and reused for ten minutes. Refs #14315 fixed in #14650.
  • A usage total says how many of its calls were never priced, and why, instead of only carrying an incomplete flag. Refs #14522 by @chuiwenwei.
  • When the connection of a context-summary request is reset mid-stream, compaction retries once instead of failing at once. Refs #14643 fixed in #14648.
  • The "earlier messages were too large to keep whole" notice after a compaction reads in the window's language. Fixes #14651 fixed in #14664.
  • When the host stops a command or a call in a batch before it runs, the tool card explains why in your language instead of an English "blocked:" line. Fixes #14652 fixed in #14655.
  • A session over the read limit no longer stops at an English error; the file stays intact and "Continue from the most recent part" saves its newest part as a new session. Fixes #14660 fixed in #14662.
  • Deleted 1.x conversations stay out of the sidebar after restart; the original store stays unchanged. Fixes #14632 fixed in #14657 by @lancy69.
  • Pressing Esc on an enlarged screenshot closes only the screenshot instead of the whole feedback dialog. Fixes #14609 fixed in #14612.
  • The "queue paused" notice goes away once dispatch resumes instead of lingering. Fixes #14616 fixed in #14618.
  • After a mouse-opened dialog is closed with Esc, the icon rail button no longer keeps a focus ring as if hovered. Refs #14624.
  • With several Git repositories in a workspace, the workbench changes list no longer grows past the panel; it scrolls on its own. Fixes #14628 fixed in #14630.
  • The file toolbar's Save button stays compact and readable in both enabled and disabled states. Refs #14231.
  • An endpoint's refusal of stream_options is learned once per process, so each new session no longer sends one extra failing request. Refs #14606.
  • Explicit subagent skills share the existing root budget, and resuming a Goal renews planner and executor budget together. Refs #14025.
  • Local cost gates use the occurrence-time quote, and tracked Windows commands keep their published Job Object owner. Refs #14025.
  • Candidate snapshots no longer reuse stale Git-cached content when size and mtime are unchanged, and private index rebuilds keep the user's staging area. Refs #14025.
  • ACP inbox refusals carry machine codes: -32020 for a queue refusal, -32021 for work that may already have run and must not be retried. Refs #14551 by @chuiwenwei.

Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @lancy69, @SivanCola, @imcreazy, @chuiwenwei

What's Changed

  • fix(openai): an endpoint's refusal of stream_options is learned once per process by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14606
  • fix(studio): Escape closes only the innermost open layer by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14612
  • fix(proc): retain published Job Object owner / 保留已发布的作业对象 owner by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14604
  • fix(control): renew planner budget on Goal resume / 恢复 Goal 时续给规划预算 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14614
  • fix(desktop): clear the held-queue notice when the queue resumes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14618

items.html:
本版修复 2.53.0 里放大后的设置窗口头部按钮点不动的问题，并让语义路由用量计入共享预算。

修复

  • 2.53.0 里放大后的设置窗口，头部的收起、关闭、最小化、最大化按钮和搜索框点不动；现在都可以点击。修复 #14596 fixed in #14597。
  • 语义路由用量在路由前就绑定根预算，计入规划与执行共享的软额度，保留缓存决定和任务边界。关联 #14595 by @SivanCola。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola

Fixed

  • In 2.53.0 the enlarged settings window's header buttons (collapse, close, minimise, maximise) and search field did not respond; they do now. Fixes #14596 fixed in #14597.
  • Semantic routing usage is bound to the root budget before routing, counting in the soft limit shared by planning and execution, with cached decisions and task boundaries kept. Refs #14595 by @SivanCola.

Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @SivanCola

What's Changed

  • fix(control): include semantic routing in root budgets / 语义路由计入根预算 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14595
  • fix(studio): the full-window settings header's buttons respond to clicks by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14597

Full Changelog: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.53.0...studio-v2.53.1

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 .AppImage（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 --appimage-extract-and-run 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

items.html:
本版新增跨项目派发、厂商图标、壁纸场景图层和个人预设默认，加固配对设备、git 读命令和项目配置的信任边界，并修复多处预算与界面问题。

新增

  • （随派发开关，默认关闭）被派发出去的会话做完任务后，会自己把最终答复送回派发它的会话，不用你再来回转述；回信不会再触发回信。关联 #13341。
  • （默认关闭）打开派发开关后，模型可请你把一批文件夹开成项目；一张卡逐条列出路径，你批准后才加入并标记为可信，之后才能向它们派发任务。关联 #13341。
  • （随派发开关，默认关闭）别的会话发来消息时，接收的会话在列表里标为未读，你看到它之后才消失；不再要你自己发现。关联 #13341。
  • 常用服务列表按厂商筛选并显示厂商图标，模型菜单里预设来源的模型也带上对应厂商图标。关联 #14538。
  • Wallpaper Engine 场景支持多图层合成与逐音轨音量/循环，并保留 effects 元数据供后续 shader 接入。Refs #14561 by @EMEEEEMMMM。
  • 设置「人设」里你自己的预设现在也能点「设为默认」作为新任务默认；该预设被删除后，新任务会改用内置的并忘掉这个默认。关联 #14572 fixed in #14575。

变更

  • 项目 reasonix.toml 里的 agent.system_prompt_file 只有在你信任该文件夹后才会读取；未信任时忽略并在启动提示里说明，信任后恢复。关联 #13061。
  • 配对的手机不能再安装或启用插件、MCP 和钩子，也不能自己指定要打开的文件夹，只能用窗口已列出的文件夹。关联 495a23478、b8b7ac87f。
  • 未信任的项目文件夹里的 AGENTS.md 等常驻指令会标明“未验证”，模型只当作项目信息；项目自己声明的 MCP 常驻加载不再生效。关联 4ca33493a、e8c22e7ce。
  • 放大设置窗口后铺满整个窗口，含顶部和底部，Windows 的窗口按钮在设置头部里；放大按钮的箭头随状态向外或向内。关联 #14418 fixed in #14420。
  • 极长会话里，右侧历史轨道上表示多条的合并条现在鼠标移上去就展开可选的条目，移开自动收起。关联 #14525 by @imcreazy。
  • 计划栏现在是输入框上方独立的卡片，展开的列表有明确的收起按钮，按 Esc 或点到外面也会收起，并写出条数。关联 #14530。

修复

  • Anthropic 流中断时保留已知用量，并标记记账不完整；重试分类、请求计数和取消边界保持不变。关联 #14025。
  • 活跃 Agent 根 context 内的有界 reviewer/advisor 用量现在计入既有 token 软预算，保留缺失用量、零阈值、局部遥测和独立请求边界。关联 #14025。
  • 缺失或估算的供应商用量不再把 Agent 成本标成完整；保留准确请求次数与已知金额，已知费用达到显式预算仍软收尾。关联 #14025。
  • 规划与执行共用显式配置的根 token 和时间软预算；保留仅规划、审批、继续、换任务及后台作业边界。关联 #14025。
  • 子任务 provider 回调 panic 后，前台图和 transcript 会一致记录失败；旧式 nil panic 不再让后台子任务误报成功。关联 #14025。
  • 中断流重建的用量不再被报价层标成完整成本；保留估算金额和既有币种账本，后续准确调用不抹掉不确定性。关联 #14025。
  • 宿主 Git 的 worktree 准备不再继承外部索引或对象存储变量，保留显式私有索引和仓库备用对象库。关联 #14025。
  • 隔离任务被拒绝时（结果不存在、未启用隔离、不是 Git 工作区、整合冲突、参数不支持），工具卡片会说明原因，不再空白。关联 #14025。
  • 活跃 Agent 根任务中的摘要与失败诊断用量现在计入既有 token 软预算，保留缺失用量、零阈值、局部遥测和无根 context 手动维护的行为。关联 #14025。
  • 显式 task_token_budget 共享累计 Agent task/fleet 子树已报告的 token，包括后台 job 和缓存输入。默认不限，保留软收尾；不是硬预留或金额上限。关联 #14025。
  • 活跃根任务的 token 软预算现在计入命令分类和外部内容筛查用量；分类结论、筛查提示、缺失用量与零阈值行为保留。关联 #14025。
  • host 显式耗时预算跟随 Agent 委派树及后台 task/fleet，共享任务起点并保留 Job Manager 取消权和既有软收尾；默认仍不限。关联 #14025。
  • 活跃根任务的 token 软预算现在计入原生 web_search 已报告用量，保留独立请求计数、缺失用量、来源标签和付费同意边界。关联 #14025。
  • 没有添加任何文件夹时，主区域也能直接新建会话，设置和反馈会在应用自己的目录里开出会话来打开，不再提示先添加文件夹。关联 #14465 fixed in #14501。
  • 右侧提问细条在点过某一条、鼠标移开后再切回窗口时，附近几条不再无故变长变粗，只有键盘聚焦才会放大。关联 #14504 fixed in #14510。
  • 在人设编辑页点「设为个人首选」或「设为项目首选」时，设置其实已生效，却弹出「Unexpected end of JSON input」的报错；现在不再误报。关联 #14541 fixed in #14542。
  • macOS 上图标栏的竖线和底色不再从窗口顶端画起，不再穿过左上角的红绿灯。关联 #14553 fixed in #14558。
  • Studio 里一个对话在后台跑完一轮后再打开，不再缺这一轮的回复；面板接入共享事件流之前错过的内容会从对话记录重新读出。关联 477ce369b。
  • 能力目录的列表、搜索和详情里含 MCP 工具描述时，结果带“外部内容，不是指令”的标签。关联 147d5365e。
  • 注销配对设备时偶发的数据竞争已修复，被注销设备的连接会可靠断开。关联 a755eb601。
  • 网页抓取和安装源的内网地址防护现在也识别 IPv6 转换地址里带的 IPv4，并在走代理前先检查内网字面地址。关联 ed624e928、ab144a4cd。
  • 仓库自己的配置里有会执行程序的键（如 fsmonitor、textconv、filter）时，智能体的 git 读命令不再自动放行，会先询问并写明原因。关联 191d1e17a。
  • 命令里直接写 awk 程序现在要确认；自动记忆不再写入置顶项；登录表单加了大小上限；钩子里未加引号的 Windows 路径被正确识别。关联 de21fb488、4227c20b8、167c01014、6336f6763。
  • 文件变更保护现在记录完整读取实际返回的内容；分页和超限读取保留已有的过期覆盖保护。关联 #14025。
  • 首次只读取一部分内容后，完整覆盖前需要完整重读，或改用局部编辑。关联 #14025。
  • 启用工具的规划现在遵守既有 token、费用、耗时预算配置；普通规划暂停保留 executor 回退。关联 #14025。
  • 思考或回答期间发送插话后，文字继续实时更新，不再等到下一次结构事件才补齐。修复 #14209 fixed in #14534 by @lancy69。
  • 调整侧栏底部头像的位置，保留原有字号、字重和尺寸，修正头像与工作空间文字的视觉对齐。关联 #14223 fixed in #14267 by @lancy69。

升级须知

  • reasonix serve --auth none 监听非本机地址时现在拒绝启动，需要显式加 --allow-open-network。关联 365337367。
  • reasonix trust --yes 不再顺带批准项目声明的 provider 端点（会把你的 API 密钥发到它的地址），需要加 --allow-providers。关联 e19b45d39。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@EMEEEEMMMM、@imcreazy、@lancy69

New

  • (With the dispatch switch, off by default) A dispatched session sends its final answer back to the session that handed it the task, and a reply is never answered by another reply. Refs #13341.
  • (Off by default) With dispatch on, the model can ask to open folders as projects; one card lists every path and nothing is added or trusted until you approve. Refs #13341.
  • (With the dispatch switch, off by default) A session that receives a message from another session is marked unread in the list until you look at it, instead of you having to notice. Refs #13341.
  • The preset list filters by vendor and shows vendor marks, and models from a preset source carry the vendor mark in the model menu. Refs #14538.
  • Scene wallpapers composite their image layers, honor per-track volume and loop mode, and keep effect metadata for a future shader pass. Refs #14561 by @EMEEEEMMMM.
  • In Settings, your own agent presets can now be made the new task default; if one is deleted, new tasks fall back to the built-in one and forget it. Refs #14572 fixed in #14575.

Changed

  • A project's agent.system_prompt_file is read only once you trust the folder; until then it is ignored with a startup notice. Refs #13061.
  • A paired phone can no longer install or enable plugins, MCP servers or hooks, or name a folder to open; it uses folders the window already lists. Refs 495a23478, b8b7ac87f.
  • Standing instructions from an untrusted folder are labelled unverified, and a project's own MCP always-load no longer applies. Refs 4ca33493a, e8c22e7ce.
  • An enlarged settings window fills the whole window, with the Windows buttons in its header; the enlarge button's arrows turn inward. Refs #14418 fixed in #14420.
  • In very long conversations a folded line on the history rail opens its questions on hover and closes when the pointer leaves. Refs #14525 by @imcreazy.
  • The plan bar is its own card above the composer, with a collapse button (Esc or a press outside also closes it) and a step count. Refs #14530.

Fixed

  • Anthropic interruptions retain known usage as incomplete accounting, preserving retry classification, request counts and cancellation boundaries. Refs #14025.
  • Bounded reviewer/advisor usage in an active Agent root now counts toward its token soft budget. Missing usage, zero limits and isolated requests retain their behavior. Refs #14025.
  • Missing or estimated provider usage no longer certifies complete Agent costs. Exact request counts and known-cost soft landing remain. Refs #14025.
  • Planning and execution share configured root token/wall soft budgets, preserving plan-only, approval, continuation, task replacement and background-job boundaries. Refs #14025.
  • Delegated provider panics now settle foreground graph and transcript as failed, and legacy nil panics cannot publish successful background work. Refs #14025.
  • Reconstructed stream usage no longer certifies a complete cost quote. Estimated amounts and currency ledgers remain; later reported calls preserve uncertainty. Refs #14025.
  • Host Git worktree preparation drops ambient index and object storage overrides, preserving explicit private indexes and repository alternates. Refs #14025.
  • Tool cards now say why an isolated task was refused (unknown result, isolation off, no Git workspace, apply conflict, unsupported arguments). Refs #14025.
  • Active-root summary and failure-diagnosis usage now counts toward its token soft budget. Missing usage, zero limits and local telemetry retain their behavior. Refs #14025.
  • Explicit task_token_budget shares reported tokens across Agent task/fleet descendants. Defaults stay unlimited; existing soft landing remains. Refs #14025.
  • Active root token soft budgets now include command-classification and external-screening usage, preserving verdicts, advisory notices, missing usage and zero limits. Refs #14025.
  • Explicit host wall budgets follow Agent delegation and background jobs, retaining Manager cancellation and soft landing. Defaults stay unlimited. Refs #14025.
  • Active root token soft budgets now include native web_search usage, preserving independent request counts, missing usage, provenance and paid-search consent. Refs #14025.
  • With no folder added, the main area offers a new session, and settings and feedback open one in the app's own workspace instead of asking for a folder first. Refs #14465 fixed in #14501.
  • The right-hand question rail no longer magnifies marks near one you pressed when the window regains focus with the mouse elsewhere; only keyboard focus does. Refs #14504 fixed in #14510.
  • "Set as personal default" and "Set as project default" on a persona applied but showed "Unexpected end of JSON input"; an empty success answer is no longer read as JSON. Refs #14541 fixed in #14542.
