items.html:
本版新增模型读图片/视频工具、网页搜索与抓取的后端设置、会话间消息的真开关与派活、打开本地网页文件和模型接口重试次数设置，并修复子代理、MCP、侧栏、输入法与反馈回复相关的一批问题。

新增

  • 设置 > 外观 > 大小 增加“界面文字”四档，只放大侧栏、设置、标签等处的文字，不动边距和控件；对话正文仍由“正文”单独设置。关联 #11577。
  • MCP 工具定义被改动时不必每次点接受：可以对某个服务器选择「跟随」，它的改动直接采用，每次仍会通知；随时可取消。关联 #12356。
  • 需要登录（401）的 MCP 服务器行上有“登录”按钮，点后等待浏览器登录；被暂挡工具旁新增“接受并以后都自动接受这个服务器的改动”，已跟随的服务器可“取消跟随”。关联 #12357。
  • 「我的反馈」的等级卡片里加了一句说明，写清楚「已落地」指反馈已被修复或实现并随新版本发布。修复 #12900 fixed in #13530。
  • 新增（默认关闭）：模型可把任务交给你另一个项目里的会话（dispatch_to_project），对方用户批准后才看到。关联 #13341。
  • 你发过消息的会话，侧栏行和标签上会出现小图标，标明对话走到哪一步（等批准、处理中、已回复、被拒绝），点它跳到该会话。关联 #13371。
  • 设置里有真正的“会话间消息”开关；被拦下的消息可“批准并记住项目”，已记住的项目在设置里一键撤销。保存后下个回合起生效。关联 #13371。
  • 声明 video_models 和 video_protocol 后，read_video 可把 MP4 原生交给能看视频的模型（通义内联、Kimi 上传），卡片显示发给了哪个模型。关联 #13399。
  • 能读图的模型多了 view_image 工具，可直接看工作区里的 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP 文件；不读图的模型不受影响。关联 #13540。
  • 本机读不到网页时，web_fetch 可回退到 DeepSeek 付费抓取接口，需先在卡片上同意；内网地址绝不外发。关联 #13541。
  • 免费搜索没有回答时，web_search 可回退到 DeepSeek 付费搜索接口；首次使用前弹出卡片，写明价格和搜索词，由你同意。关联 #13541。
  • web_search 可用你自己运行的 SearXNG 免费搜索，在用户配置里设置，默认关闭。关联 #13541。
  • 设置 > 工具与权限 里可设置网页搜索和抓取的后端与先后顺序；付费后端的计费同意是单独的开关，不会替你勾选。新开的窗格生效。关联 #13551。
  • 对话里点一个你授权过的额外文件夹里的文件路径，现在能在工作台里只读打开它（不能保存）；文件夹之外的路径仍打不开。关联 #13582 fixed in #13589。
  • 新增用户设置 agent.max_provider_retries：模型接口连接失败后的重试次数，默认仍是 10；设为 0 则一直重试到你取消，适合无人值守的长任务。关联 #13526。
  • 目标现在显示用量：桌面端展开计划栏能看到状态、轮数、请求数、tokens 和用时，停下时说明原因；终端页脚同样显示。关联 #13663。
  • 工作台浏览器里打开本地网页、SVG 或 PDF 文件时，右上角按钮可用系统默认程序打开它，旁边注明网页脚本会照常运行。关联 #13665 fixed in #13668。
  • 编辑器（ACP）新增只读方法 session/info（模型、工作区、预设、自动放行、缓存）和 session/mcpServers（已配置的 MCP 服务器及启用状态）。关联 #13644。
  • 编辑器（ACP）可对单个会话重连、断开 MCP 服务器，并提交扩展表单；项目声明但未获批准的服务器不会被启动，只返回要运行的命令。关联 #13660。
  • 编辑器（ACP）里付费搜索、付费抓取的同意可以选“本会话允许”或“始终允许”（存进你的设置），重连后卡片上仍保留这个选择。关联 #13606。

变更

  • 输入框恢复 1.x 手感：悬停或聚焦时边框扫过一圈光（运行中、系统减弱动画时不播）；框内不再印“空闲/运行中”，状态仍读给读屏软件，运行时钟照旧。关联 #13253 fixed in #13567。
  • 选了人民币或美元显示费用、但模型价格不是官方价目表里的价格时，设置里会说明哪些模型无法换算；服务商页的价格行提供「恢复官方价」，缓存命中价为 0 时提示费用偏低。关联 #13513。
  • 子代理并发数和并行写者数默认不再限制（原为 6 和 3），可在用户配置里设上限；嵌套深度默认 8，设 0 取消。关联 #13526。
  • 会话队列不再限制排队 64 条；想限制时在用户配置里设 agent.max_queued_inputs，队列的字节上限仍然生效。关联 #13526。
  • 侧栏不再限制只能记住 32 个项目；想限制时在用户配置的 [desktop] 里设 max_workspaces。关联 #13526。
  • 左上角品牌标志旁的“STUDIO”徽标由实心深色块改为透明底、细边框、淡色文字，不再像一条提示；外形尺寸不变。关联 #13601。
  • MCP 登录：打开浏览器之前先告诉你服务器要把你带去哪个主机，批准后才打开；可选“始终允许”，只对这个服务器和这个主机生效。关联 #12357。
  • /peer 和会话间消息的接口现在会说明你发出的消息处于等待、处理中、已回复还是被拒绝。关联 #13341。
  • 带图片的排队消息不能在运行中途插入，要等本轮结束；队列里这一行现在写明“含图片，本轮结束后发送”，不再只显示“尚未送达”。关联 #13563。
  • 子代理列表里已结束的任务现在写明状态“已交付”并带上耗时，用绿色标出，不再只显示一个秒数。关联 #13596 fixed in #13599。
  • 配置工作目录时会显示准备的实际阶段、长时间等待、成功、失败重试和取消；失败或取消保留原任务与附件，已有隔离目录也在同一入口可搜。关联 #13598 by @SivanCola。

修复

  • 压缩摘要复用已发送的系统提示和工具目录；纯文本历史还复用对话前缀，含工具的历史继续脱敏。关联 #11860。
  • Windows SSH 远端通过脚本文件启动内核，避免 WMI 的编码命令启动失败，并正确处理中文路径。关联 #12750。
  • 修复输入“/”后技能列表出现很慢的问题（装了大量插件技能时尤其明显）：短时间内的重复补全不再逐个重读技能文件。关联 #13197 fixed in #13470。
  • 辅助会话可收起为标题栏以露出正文，展开后保留草稿、引用和回答；收起不会取消正在进行的请求。关联 #13288。
  • 同一仓库里多个项目声明同名 MCP 服务器（内容不同）时，各自启用互不覆盖，重启后都保持已启用。关联 #13527。
  • 共享事件流迟迟打不开时（旧版内核或代理不认这条路径），窗格 10 秒后改读各自的事件流，页面不再停在“已连接却收不到事件”。关联 #13562 by @tongsailong。
  • 辅助会话面板改为从输入框上方弹出，不再固定在右上角、盖住右侧文件树；按 Esc 或点 × 关闭后焦点回到辅助会话按钮。关联 #13539 fixed in #13557。
  • 两个窗口或项目用同名但启动方式不同的 MCP 服务器时，不再每次启动互相冲掉握手缓存。关联 #13560。
  • 没有代理、读不到版本目录时，打开设置页会让「版本」等上 15 秒；现在各处共用一次读取，失败只记 20 秒，点「重试」才重新读。关联 #13565。
  • 原目录和隔离目录的会话归入同一项目，并标出实际目录；原目录失效时使用仍存在的目录，手动选择隔离目录仍打开该目录。关联 #13586 by @SivanCola。
  • 同一文件夹被写成不同形式（大小写、斜杠方向、末尾分隔符）时，窗格与侧栏项目对不上，标签和列表可能缺少已打开标记；窗格的会话找不到列表行时，日志里会留一行说明。关联 #13600。
  • 断网恢复后，侧栏“进行中”计数不再卡在已经结束的会话上（没打开的窗格也会在网络恢复后重新读到状态）。关联 #13604 fixed in #13623。
  • agent 打开、刷新或翻页内置浏览器时，不再打断你正在进行的输入法输入（拼音不会被当成字母直接上屏）。关联 #13605。
  • agent 打开、导航或显示内置浏览器页面时，不再把你正在输入的键盘焦点抢走；你自己点进那个页面则照常。关联 #13605。
  • 设置页左侧已选中的分区，鼠标停在上面时不再被悬停样式盖掉：浅色主题保持选中底色，两种主题下图标都保持选中时的颜色。关联 #13610。
  • 反馈刚提交、状态还是“已收到”时，如果维护者已经留言提问，现在可以直接在这条下面回复，不必等它被登记为 GitHub 议题；审核中的反馈仍不能回复。关联 #13626。
  • 主会话的模型不读图、子代理的模型读图时，子代理现在也有 view_image 可以看图，不再错用视频工具；父会话的工具表不变。关联 #13642。
  • 命令行里输入斜杠命令时，同一条技能发现警告不再每次按键重复打印、盖住输入行和状态栏；每条警告每个会话只出现一次。关联 #13655。
  • 后台任务一段时间没往自己的输出里写内容时，界面上的警告改成中文，写明任务名和已安静的时长，不再显示英文原文。关联 #13566 fixed in #13568。
  • 多个会话同时运行时，超长输出偶尔被截断的问题。关联 #13620。
  • Windows 上默认端口落在系统保留段（Hyper-V、WSL、Docker）时，网页服务现在会顺延到下一个可用端口，不再直接启动失败。关联 #13649。
  • 网络抖动时读取窗格列表失败，不再关掉所有标签并把你切到别的窗格；共享事件流首次连上后若断开，重连不再漏掉中间的事件。关联 #13603。
  • 会话标题在后台生成时，首条消息改了会重新生成，较慢的旧结果不会盖掉新标题。关联 #13611。
  • 网络、壁纸和账号面板失败时，按界面语言说明原因：不支持的壁纸格式、被拒绝的代理、登录请求已过期都不再显示英文原文或路径加状态码。关联 #13621 by @xxoingr、#13637 by @xxoingr。
  • 会话收件箱的队列暂时读不出来时，不再当成空队列而停止投递，会稍后重试。关联 #13438 by @chuiwenwei。
  • Windows 上读取 PDF 引用超时被取消时，不再因为结束进程命令无响应而卡住。关联 #13614 by @xxoingr。

升级须知

  • 本版无需用户操作。唯一改变默认行为的是子代理并发数和并行写者数不再有默认上限；想保留上限，在用户配置里设置。关联 #13526。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola、@tongsailong、@xxoingr、@chuiwenwei

This release adds image and video reading tools for the model, web search and fetch backend settings, a real switch and dispatch for session messages, opening a local page in the default program and a provider retry setting, and fixes a batch of sub-agent, MCP, sidebar, IME and feedback-reply problems.

New

  • Appearance > Size has an Interface text step (small to larger) that enlarges only sidebar, settings and tab text, not spacing or controls; body text keeps its own. Refs #11577.
  • For an MCP server you trust, choose to follow it: its changed tool definitions are taken without a click, each still announced, and you can undo it. Refs #12356.
  • an MCP server that answered 401 has a Sign in button; withheld tools gain "accept and follow this server's changes", and a followed server can be un-followed. Refs #12357.
  • the My feedback level card now says what "shipped" counts: a report that was fixed or built and released in a version. Fixes #12900 fixed in #13530.
  • the model can hand a task to a session in another of your projects (dispatch_to_project); that project's user approves first. Refs #13341.
  • a session you have written to carries a small icon on its row and tab saying where the exchange stands (waiting, working, replied, declined); click it to open that session. Refs #13371.
  • Settings has real session-message switches; a held message can be approved with its project remembered, and revoked in Settings. Applies from the next turn. Refs #13371.
  • declare video_models and video_protocol and read_video hands an MP4 to a model that watches video (DashScope inline, Kimi upload); the card shows which. Refs #13399.
  • a model that reads images gets a view_image tool that shows it a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file in the workspace; text-only models are unchanged. Refs #13540.
  • when this machine cannot read a page, web_fetch can fall back to DeepSeek's paid Fetch API after you agree on a card; internal addresses are never sent. Refs #13541.
  • when the free search did not answer, web_search can fall back to DeepSeek's paid Search API, after a card shows the price and the query and you agree. Refs #13541.
  • web_search can use your own SearXNG instance for free searches, set in your user config, off by default. Refs #13541.
  • Settings > Tools and permissions sets the web search and fetch backends and their order; consent to be billed is its own switch, never ticked for you. New panes only. Refs #13551.
  • A path in the conversation that points into an extra folder you granted now opens read-only in the workbench (no saving); a path outside every granted folder still does not open. Refs #13582 fixed in #13589.
  • Added the user setting agent.max_provider_retries: how often a failed provider connection is retried, still 10 by default; 0 keeps trying until you cancel, for long unattended runs. Refs #13526.
  • A goal now shows its usage: the desktop plan fold lists state, turns, requests, tokens and work time and says why it stopped; the terminal footer shows the same. Refs #13663.
  • A local HTML, SVG or PDF file in the workbench browser can now be opened in the system default program from the toolbar button; a note says page scripts run as usual. Refs #13665 fixed in #13668.
  • ACP gains read-only session/info (model, workspace, preset, auto-approve, cache) and session/mcpServers (configured servers, on or off, no commands). Refs #13644.

items.html:
本版新增会话间消息（实验）、跨项目的对话正文搜索、模型读视频、更新方式“自动下载”和可选起始分支的独立工作目录，并修复多个会话同时开着时的界面卡死、停止无效，以及一批界面和英文界面问题。

新增

  • 设置里新增“会话间消息（实验）”：可查看本机别的会话、给它们发文字；收到的文字在输入框上方等你批准，批准后才交给模型。默认关闭。关联 #11376。
  • 开启“会话间消息”后，模型多了 list_peers 和 send_peer_message 两个工具；发送前先问你（卡片显示收件会话和全文），对方的用户批准后才交给它的模型。关联 #11376。
  • 侧栏搜索除了按名称筛选，停顿后还会搜所有项目里对话的正文，列出命中的对话和片段，点一下就打开。关联 #11942。
  • 在 Windows 缩放 100% 的宽屏（2400 像素以上）上，首次使用会问一次“界面是不是偏小”，可一键放大并可恢复，不会擅自改动。关联 #11962。
  • 模型来源列表的小圆点会记住上一次测试：失败是红点、悬停可见原因，通过是空心圈，换了地址或密钥就清掉。关联 #12040。
  • 工具调用跑了 10 秒还没结束时，卡片上出现“只停止这一条调用”，点了只结束这一条，本轮继续，模型会被告知该调用是被你停止的。关联 #12254。
  • 对话里的图片也能从你授权给当前工作区的文件夹（设置 → 沙盒 → 额外文件夹）里显示，文件夹之外的本地图片仍显示为占位框。关联 #13125。
  • 新会话的分支入口升级为“配置工作目录”：可选起始分支，首次发送时创建独立的 worktree；已有对话仍可切换分支。关联 #13264 fixed in #13273 by @SivanCola。
  • 设置 › 版本 › 更新方式新增“自动下载”（默认关）：后台下载并校验新版本，空闲时提示“重启并更新”，不会自动安装或重启。关联 #13291。
  • 任务运行时，输入框上方的状态条会写出本轮已运行多久（如“read_file · 1m 6s”），不用回到对话区看计时。关联 #13346、#13253。
  • 反馈窗口里添加的截图可以点击放大查看（发送和回复反馈两处），按 Esc 关闭，截图仍保留在草稿里。关联 #13350。
  • 侧栏首次读取项目和会话超过 15 秒时，会说明仍在读取并给出“重试”，重试会另起一次请求，不再排在卡住的请求后面。关联 #13345。
  • 输入框里的计划折叠在没有计划时显示 /goal 目标；对话、运行分析、工作台三个视图有了快捷键（Ctrl/⌘ 1、2、3）和命令面板入口。关联 #13369。
  • 设置里新增“多个会话同时写一个项目”开关（乐观模式，默认关），只对之后新开的会话生效。关联 #13384、#13392。
  • 用户配置里设 tools.mcp_resources = true 后，模型可读已连接 MCP 服务器列出的资源，每次先请你批准（默认关闭）。关联 #13385。
  • 读取 MCP 资源时，服务器声明的资源模板（如 doc://item/{id}）生成的地址也可读，其它地址仍被拒绝。关联 #13385。
  • 「我的反馈」顶部新增吸顶筛选条（全部、新回复、需要你回复、未结束、已结束，带数量），条目多时也能找到有新进展的。修复 #13388 fixed in #13404。
  • 工具调用卡片上多了“把结果带到末尾”按钮，点一下就在对话末尾再显示这条调用的原始输出，不用再翻找。关联 #13394。
  • 模型现在能“看”视频：read_video 用本机 ffmpeg 均匀抽几帧作为图片给模型（看不到声音和动作），需要读图模型；没装 ffmpeg 会明确说明。关联 #13399。
  • 命令行发布包现在随带网页界面，解压后直接运行 reasonix serve 就能在浏览器里打开。修复 #13406 fixed in #13423。
  • 命令要访问不在 allowed_domains 里的网站时，批准卡多了“始终允许”，把该网站写进你自己的列表，以后不再询问。关联 #13478。
  • 用户配置新增 agent.goal_auto_retry（默认 0）：目标因完成度检查不可用而暂停时，按退避间隔自动重试，最多这么多次。关联 #13478。
  • 设置 → 工具新增“计划批准”开关（也可在用户配置设 agent.plan_approval = "auto"）：打开后提交的计划不再等你点批准，默认关闭。关联 #13478。
  • 点击“后台任务”里正在运行的任务可查看它的输出（每 2 秒刷新，可复制、可停止），不影响模型自己读取输出。关联 #4783。
  • 设置了“同时保留的会话标签数”后，窗口因满额收起某个会话时会提示是哪一个，并说明对话仍在列表里。关联 #13419。
  • 用户配置新增 sandbox.egress_unlisted = "allow"：清单外的主机不再询问，每个主机只提示一次；拒绝名单照旧；默认关闭。关联 #13478。
  • 后台任务列表现在显示模型给任务起的名字（bash 新增可选的 description），悬停、聚焦或长按会弹出完整名字和完整命令，可选中复制。关联 #13458。

变更

  • 添加模型来源时，先填协议、地址和 API Key，来源名称挪到最后，连接后自动生成，不必先想名字。关联 #12040。
  • 模型服务的联网搜索、思考参数、上下文续接三个开关不再点一下就写入，而是进连接表单的草稿，点“保存”才生效，“还原”可撤回。关联 #12040。
  • 切换 Git 分支时，输入框里的分支按钮会写出“正在切换到 xxx…”，不再只是变灰。关联 #12780。
  • 侧栏“全部 / 进行中 / 置顶 / 归档”那一行去掉了多余的放大镜，会话搜索走顶栏。关联 #13023。
  • 会话运行中已保存的压缩结果与历史对不上、改发完整历史时，会提示原因，不再悄悄放大上下文。关联 #13148、#13295。
  • 设置保存因配置文件读不出而被拒时，提示直接写出是哪个文件。关联 #13220。
  • 创建独立工作目录只使用已提交的代码，草稿附件随任务迁移，失败时保留原草稿；聊天区五个配置菜单统一了字号、间距、圆角与选中态。关联 #13264 fixed in #13273 by @SivanCola。
  • 窄屏聊天区的空输入框工具栏在获得焦点时保持紧凑，输入文字、添加附件或打开菜单时才展开，点按时按钮不会在手指下移位。关联 #13264 fixed in #13273 by @SivanCola。
  • 改了无法读出范围的内容后，结束前的提示不再说“重做一遍就行”：只能用 conclude_blocked 说明哪一处无法确认，或交给你；同一项只完整解释一次。关联 #13293。
  • 一个文件夹里会话很多时，重启后的首次读取不再逐个打开会话文件，只重读有变化的会话，改名后刷新也快得多。关联 #13345。
  • 自动命名失败时会说明原因（标题模型超时、没返回文字，或接口拒绝并给出状态码和原话），不再只说“请重试”。关联 #13353。
  • 去掉会话上方“对话 / 运行分析 / 工作台”一行：运行分析和工作台改为顶栏右端图标（再点返回对话），计划只在输入框里。关联 #13369。
  • 辅助会话入口从顶部视图条移到输入框工具栏（附件按钮之后的聊天图标），悬停有说明，打开时图标保持按下态。关联 #13369。
  • 子代理工具（task、fleet）的说明讲清了：开启 write_lease = optimistic 后，不传 write_paths 的写入者只占正在写的路径，不再占住整个工作区。关联 #13395 fixed in #13397。
  • 内核带失败码退出时，崩溃目录里会留下一个写明退出码和原因的文件，不再是空文件或被直接删掉。关联 #13433。
  • 对话里卡片图标下面的竖线轨道和“执行过程”折叠区左边的线已去掉，同一次工具调用在不同位置的样子更一致。关联 #13456。
  • “带到末尾的结果”改成和执行过程里一样的一行（无边框、图标方块、竖线）；暗色主题下执行过程的行也不再有整块底色。关联 #13456。
  • 开着多个会话标签时，切换标签和侧栏筛选更快：切换不再让所有隐藏会话整页重绘。关联 #13326。
  • 权限批准卡片上“本会话允许 / 始终允许”下多了一行说明：前者只在本次会话有效、不写磁盘，后者写入用户配置的权限规则，可在设置里撤销。关联 e54381d4f。
  • 辅助会话不再限制同时打开 3 个；想限制时在用户配置里设 agent.max_side_sessions。关联 #13526。
  • 安全加固：手写进收件夹的会话间消息正文，读取时同样清掉控制字符和方向覆盖符，假冒不了终端或审批界面。关联 #11376。
  • 安全加固：会话间消息里的会话名和发件人名读取时清掉换行、转义序列和标记，伪造的记录文件塞不进模型或终端。关联 #11376。
  • 设置“提问超时”后，模型交还任务清单却无人回应时，也会按此时间自动继续并写明假设，连续最多 3 次；默认关闭。关联 #13478。
  • 改进：本机所有窗格共用一条事件流，开多少窗格都只占 2 个连接，停止与提交不再被挤住。关联 #13533。
  • 对话里的批准、提问、记忆、守卫复核、扩展卡片等现在用同一种外壳：同样的圆角、边框和底色，标题栏不再单独填色，警告和错误也不再给整圈边框着色。关联 #13456。
  • 对话里低风险的“守卫复核：已允许”和“记住了”改成一行（“忘记”按钮在行内）；被拦截或中高风险的复核仍是卡片。关联 #13456。
  • 对话里展开一个步骤后，详情改成四周细线的面板，不再是左边一条竖线。关联 #13456。
  • 侧栏左上角的品牌标题改成一行：字标右边是紧凑的实心“STUDIO”徽章，与字标垂直居中，明暗主题下位置一致。关联 #13456。
  • 对话里的主机提示（切换模型、告警、失败等）改成一行提示条：没有边框、标题栏和底色，只有图标的颜色表示严重程度。关联 #13456。

修复

  • 编辑模型来源时，“读取可用模型”按表单里还没保存的地址、密钥和协议去连，不再只测已保存的那一份。关联 #12040。
  • 选中 /review、/security-review 后不写任务直接回车，现在会按默认范围审查当前改动，不再被拒绝。关联 #12883。
  • 压缩后保留的失败工具结果不再随压缩轮数累积：它们有独立预算（窗口的 5%），更早的并入摘要。关联 #13148。
  • 会话标签页的圆点在回合结束后不会再偶尔一直“呼吸”。关联 #13254。
  • 更多只读 git 命令（merge-base、分支/远程/配置/暂存的查看形式）不再被当成“无法证明只读的改动”，也不再触发验证提示。关联 #13293。
  • 只读的 gh 命令（pr、issue、run、release、repo 的 list 与 view，pr checks，gh api 的读取）不再触发验证提示。关联 #13293。
  • 回复下方的复制、引用、更多按钮不再在这条回复的工具还在运行时出现，不会让人误以为任务已经结束。关联 #13343。
  • 回复里用 Markdown 写的本地图片：工作区内的图片现在能直接显示，工作区外的不再显示成裂图，改为带说明的占位框。关联 #13354。
  • 用 / 选好技能或命令后继续输入正文，不再一直弹出“正在加载命令与技能…”，只在光标处于斜杠词里时才显示。关联 #13358 fixed in #13361。
  • 发送带图片的消息时，较高的图片（如手机截图）不再撑出缩略图框、盖住消息文字，每张图都固定为缩略图大小。关联 #13368。
  • 从“已归档”里打开一个会话后，“全部”列表不再多出一条叫“新会话”的空行。修复 #13377 fixed in #13386。
  • 回答提问卡片时若内核没及时回应，错误提示现在有边距和醒目颜色，不再贴着卡片边缘。关联 #13379。
  • 已打开的会话不再因列表的筛选、搜索或分页丢掉自己的那一行，标签页重新显示会话标题，不再是“新会话”。修复 #13402 fixed in #13407。
  • 从旧版 Reasonix 找回会话后，原来的项目文件夹会自动出现在侧栏里，找回的会话不再“导入了却看不到”。修复 #13412 fixed in #13413。
  • Linux 上文件夹选择器弹不出来时，“添加文件夹”和“找回旧版会话”改为让你输入路径，不再毫无反应。修复 #13421 fixed in #13424。
  • 从旧版找回的会话带着旧版显示的标题；之前找回的那些，再点一次“找回旧版会话”就会补上标题，不再显示成 v4-文件名。关联 #13439。
  • 英文界面下，“项目自带的钩子要你批准”等 15 条提示不再显示成中文，并加了检查防止以后新增提示漏掉英文。修复 #13441 fixed in #13447。
  • 输入框下方“执行权限”下拉的小箭头比旁边的下拉箭头更小、位置偏下，现在与其他下拉一致。修复 #13472 fixed in #13509。
  • 选了中文后，输入 /goal、/memory、/mcp、/theme、/feedback 等命令弹出的子菜单说明不再是英文。修复 #13493 fixed in #13505。
  • 键盘用户：设置、命令面板等对话框现在把 Tab 键留在对话框里，关闭后焦点回到原处；远程会话的“删除”按钮在浅色主题下聚焦时有了焦点环。关联 d191b73fc。
  • 手机宽度下，连接设置里“模型”标题不再被挤成竖排两行，右边的按钮换到下一行。关联 #12040。
  • 设置里“网络 → 测试连接”的每一步结果按界面语言显示：英文界面不再出现中文的步骤名、提示和“key 被拒了”之类的句子。关联 #12040。
  • 修复：会话很多（约 2000 个）时左侧项目栏刷新很慢；Windows 上每次刷新从约 0.9 秒降到约 0.1 秒。关联 #13176。
  • 修复：设置 › 存储里“配置与凭据”一行不再把同一文件夹里的会话与归档也算进去，Windows 默认安装下它原先会显示成几十 GB。关联 #13345。
  • 修复：输入框下方“执行权限”在“全部放行”状态下，小箭头和警告图标现在与文字同色（此前箭头是灰色，浅色主题下图标比文字浅）。关联 #13472 fixed in #13509。
  • 修复：新会话在还没有任何计价时，底栏不再显示“本轮 ¥0.00”这个并非来自你设置的占位，第一次计价后才出现本轮费用。关联 #13513。
  • 修复：手动连接的 MCP 服务器现在也会像自动启动的那样记下握手结果，下一次会话不用重新握手；此前快速关闭会话会丢掉它。关联 #13485。
  • 修复：开着五六个会话标签时，停止和发送不再因浏览器连接数用完而卡住：不显示也不在运行的标签会放掉实时连接，显示时接着断点读。关联 #13491。
  • 修复：会话很多时，刚启动后第一次载入左侧项目栏很慢；Windows 上约 2000 个会话从约 10 秒降到约 1 秒。关联 #13176。
  • 修复：模型用 await_user 交还清单后，系统不再因“改动没验证”等缺口自己开新一轮，回合停下等你输入。关联 #13467。

升级须知

  • 设置 > 外观新增“同时保留的会话标签数”，默认 0：打开的会话都保留（此前超过 4 个会悄悄收起）；设成 N 才收起最久没动的空闲会话。关联 #13419。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola

Adds messages between sessions (experimental), cross-project text search, video reading, auto-download updates and worktrees from a chosen branch; fixes the many-sessions freeze and UI bugs.

New

  • Settings gain Messages between sessions (experimental): list other local sessions, send them text, and approve what arrives in a bar above the composer. Off by default. Refs #11376.
  • With messages between sessions on, the model gains list_peers and send_peer_message; sending asks you first and shows the recipient and full text, and the other user must approve. Refs #11376.
  • The sidebar search now also looks through the text of conversations in every project once you pause, listing the matching conversations with a passage; click one to open it. Refs #11942.
  • On a wide display (2400 px or more) at 100% scaling, Studio asks once whether the interface is too small and offers 125% or 150% with a restore; it never resizes by itself. Refs #11962.
  • The dot on each model source remembers its last test: red for a failed one with the cause on hover, a hollow ring for a pass, cleared when the address or key changes. Refs #12040.
  • A tool call still running after 10 seconds offers "Stop only this call": it ends that call, the turn goes on, and the model is told you stopped it. Refs #12254.
  • Pictures in a conversation also load from a folder you granted this workspace (Settings, Sandbox, extra folders); local pictures elsewhere still show a placeholder. Refs #13125.

items.html:
本版本新增会话概览、从源文件夹更新技能、更新提醒、按模型填写价格、子代理乐观写入范围和从分支创建独立工作区副本，并修复停止卡住、后台任务状态、同仓库项目互相等待写入、压缩恢复和一批界面问题。

新增

  • 「我的反馈」新增「账号关联」：登录后可手动把这台电脑关联到账号，随时解除；默认关闭、不改变额度，网页账号页之后据此显示反馈等级。关联 #13141。
  • 会话右键菜单新增“从最近回复分叉”，会话还在执行时也能从最近一个已完成的回复分叉；旧回复下的分叉按钮执行中同样可用。关联 #13177。
  • 新增：侧边栏会话右键菜单加入“自动命名”，一步生成并保存标题，无需先打开重命名，关联 #13195 fixed in #13199
  • 新增：设置 › 会话折叠 › 思考过程新增「收起并预览首句」，收起的思考在同一行后面显示首句（超长以 … 截断）。默认不变。关联 #13212。
  • 新增：网页版 Studio 页面开着不关、内核升级后，会提示“这个页面不是最新版”并给出刷新按钮，不再出现 n.filter 之类的报错，关联 #13213 fixed in #13218
  • 新增：删除带有恢复副本的会话时，确认框可以选择“连同 N 份副本删除”，不用再一个一个删，关联 #13221 fixed in #13225
  • 新增：文件窗口里可以用“用其他程序打开项目”菜单，在 VS Code、终端等已安装的程序中打开当前项目，关联 #13227
  • 新增：内置浏览器的页签可以双击重命名，不再只能显示网址，关联 #13228 fixed in #13267
  • 新增：Windows 上可以给「指定一个可执行文件」填写启动参数（例如 wsl.exe -d 发行版 -- /bin/bash），保存前带着参数实际运行验证，无法运行则不保存。关联 #13247。
  • 新增：右侧文件窗口的工具栏加了“在系统文件管理器中显示此文件”按钮，不用再去文件列表里右键，关联 #13255
  • 新增：回复反馈时可以附上截图（粘贴或选择，最多 3 张），只发给维护者，由维护者决定是否公开。关联 #13258。
  • 新增：可以从选定的分支创建独立的工作区副本，指定的分支不存在时会明确提示。关联 #13271。
  • 新增：设置里「子代理的写入范围」可开启乐观模式（默认关闭）：没有声明 write_paths 的子代理不再占住整个工作区，可与主会话并发写。关联 #13274。
  • 新增：连接编辑器里可以按模型填写每百万 token 的价格（输入、输出、缓存命中、货币），没价格的模型在用量里仍显示「未知」。关联 #13276。
  • 新增：设置 → 版本里的“更新方式”。默认“手动”不做后台联网；选“提醒”后每天查一次版本目录，有新版本时设置图标出现小点。两种方式都不下载、不安装、不重启。关联 #13291。
  • 新增：点击输入框下的“缓存”数字打开会话概览：请求、Token、缓存命中、工作时长、费用及按来源明细，各数字旁写明口径，费用不完整时只给下限。关联 #13297。
  • 新增：会话概览里加上“上下文窗口”：已使用、容量、各类占比与自动压缩线，标明是下一次请求的当前值而非累计，可直达上下文详情。关联 #13297。
  • 新增：技能列表会标出从某个文件夹安装的技能副本与来源文件夹是否一致（来源有更新、副本被改过、两边都改过、来源不见了）。关联 #13311。
  • 新增：技能列表里，从本机文件夹复制安装的技能在来源有变化时可以“从源文件夹更新…”：先预览每个文件的改动（脚本需逐项展开），确认后才替换，失败会保留原副本。关联 #13311。

变更

  • 侧栏底部的「发送反馈」现在用强调色加粗显示，更容易找到（不加动画；错误提示上的「报告此问题」和命令面板入口不变）。关联 #13048。
  • MCP 服务器把耗时的工具调用作为任务返回时，现在会自动跟进到结果，不再返回空结果或要求任务扩展而报错。关联 #13108。
  • MCP 任务超过工具超时后，会转成后台任务继续运行，可用 wait、bash_output 取结果、kill_shell 取消，不再直接超时失败。关联 #13108。
  • 技能列表里，技能声明的许可（license）、运行要求（compatibility）和附加信息（metadata）现在可以展开查看；这些只是显示，不影响技能怎么运行。关联 #13110。
  • 会话很多时侧栏刷新、改名更快：每次刷新不再逐个会话解析路径（Windows 上 2100 个会话约从 1.2 秒降到 0.4 秒）。关联 #13176。
  • 用量页的「每日明细」现在最新一天排在最上面，不用再滚到底才能看到最近的数据。关联 #13179 fixed in #13182。
  • 打开文件失败时按真实原因提示：只有文件确实不存在才说“找不到文件”；被软链接或权限拒绝的文件不再被误报为不存在。关联 #13180。
  • 输入 / 弹出命令列表更快：补全命令名时不再每次读取插件包、模型和记忆数据，装了大量插件技能时尤其明显。关联 #13197。
  • 输入 / 或 @ 时，上一个按键还没返回的补全请求会被取消，不再堆积占满连接。关联 #13197。
  • 设置了提问超时后，提问卡片会显示“N 秒后自动跳过，点任意处保留”的倒计时，接管后消失；命令行界面同步显示。关联 #13210。
  • 分支芯片区分“不是 Git 仓库”“Git 拒绝打开”“Git 没有及时响应”，并显示 Git 的原话，不再统一说不是仓库。关联 #13217。
  • 启动时 Git 没及时响应不再让分支芯片整场会话都显示没有仓库：第一次读取时会再试一次。关联 #13217。
  • 改进：配置文件无法读取导致设置没保存时，提示会指到「设置」里查看出错位置并修复，关联 #13220
  • 优化：切换本地 Git 分支成功后立即使用切换结果更新界面，变更列表单独刷新，状态摘要的三项读取并行进行。关联 #12780。
  • 改进：会话标签页里正在工作的会话状态点会呼吸闪动，已完成未读也直接由这个点表示（不再多出一个小点），关联 #13254
  • 改进：带 write_paths 的子代理调用不允许的工具时，拒绝原因现在说明缘由和下一步（不要重试，改用文件工具或收尾汇报）。关联 #13269。
  • 改进：压缩完成的卡片在折叠后仍占窗口很大一块时，会说明剩下的是什么（模型回复、工具输出、用户消息各多少，最大的一条是谁）。关联 #13284。
  • 改进：更新下载卡住时，版本面板会说明“已重连 N 次”；重连仍无效则提示下载卡住，并给出重试或手动下载的办法。关联 #13291。
  • 改变：输入框下的缓存百分比不再把服务商未区分缓存的输入算作未命中，与会话概览同一口径；这类输入多的会话读数更高。关联 #13297。
  • 改进：对话右下角“回到顶部/底部”的按钮更淡更小，改为圆角方形、半透明浅底，不再是深色圆形。关联 #13303 fixed in #13310。
  • 改进：给“额外可写文件夹”选择技能安装位置时，拒绝原因现在说明出路：把技能源文件夹用“登记”方式安装，并在源文件夹里修改。关联 #13311。

修复

  • 修复超长会话里自动压缩反复放弃的问题：摘要模型没看到的改动不再被当成「摘要丢了全部改动」，由系统补记后正常折叠。关联 #13013。
  • 修复：重命名或复制的文件在 Git 变更里的新增/删除行数现在能正确统计。关联 #13175 by @kevin9327。
  • 修复鼠标移向状态栏里的上下文浮窗时它立刻消失、导致点不到「立即压缩」和「管理 MCP」的问题（浮窗与触发处之间的空隙现在会保持悬停）。关联 #13178 fixed in #13181。
  • 修复：设置了壁纸时，标签栏下沿不再是一条生硬的横线，而是向下柔和渐隐，关联 #13194 fixed in #13198
  • 修复：已过期的置顶记忆不再进入稳定前缀、不再遮蔽全局指引、也不再占用置顶字数预算。关联 #13201 by @chuiwenwei。
  • 修复：关闭一个内核里已不存在的会话窗格时不再弹出 “no runtime r1”，按已关闭处理，关联 #13204 fixed in #13208
  • 修复：电脑崩溃后会话检查点的最后一行写了一半时，不再丢掉其余完好的对话轮次。关联 #13241 by @chuiwenwei。
  • 修复对话栏变窄时输入框工具栏（模型、思考强度、停下按钮）折成两行错位的问题：现在始终保持一行，放不下时模型名先缩略。关联 #13259。
  • 修复：设置了独立的 REASONIX_HOME 时，配置编辑锁不再写到系统默认的 ~/.reasonix，保持独立目录自包含。关联 #13275。
  • 修复：窗口截图的对话框已经关闭时，截图流程会安静停止，不再报“window is not defined”类错误。关联 #13285。
  • 修复：「恢复旧会话」现在能导入 1.x 桌面版新存储（desktop-sessions-v5）里的会话，此前它们被悄悄跳过；无法使用的编号会列入“未导入”。关联 #13290 fixed in #13296。
  • 修复：项目菜单里的“文件管理器”“终端”现在显示中文，且“用文件管理器打开”不再与“在文件管理器中显示”重复。关联 #13292 fixed in #13298。
  • 修复：改动范围无法确认时，结束前的提示会说明检查解决不了它，要换用会报告路径的工具重做。关联 #13293。
  • 修复：打开会话时，之前保存的压缩结果若因历史变化或模型/工作区不同而无法复用，现在会提示原因，不再悄悄改发完整历史。关联 #13295。
  • 修复：Windows 上停止任务时，如果系统的 taskkill 卡住，整个“停止”不再被它无限期拖住：最多等 10 秒，之后直接结束主进程。关联 #13299。
  • 修复：顶部的计划按钮不再停在标签行中间，而是靠右紧挨“辅助会话”。关联 #13302 fixed in #13307。
  • 修复：停止后把同一句话再发一次，不再在待发队列里叠出多份；原来未生效的那条被重新排队，恢复后只会回答一次。关联 #13318。
  • 修复：停止后台任务后，右下角的任务列表会立即刷新；对已在停止中的任务再点停止，会说明“已请求停止，进程还没退出”，不再误报“已经不在运行”。关联 #13319。
  • 修复：从源文件夹更新技能后，记录写入失败会自动重试一次；仍失败时再点一次更新即可补上记录，技能不再被误判为“副本被改过”。关联 #13311。
  • 修复：对话右下角“回到会话顶部/跳到最新”按钮一次点击直达两端；原来的“逐个展开块”跳法改为按住 Shift 点击。关联 #13326、#13229。
  • 修复：会话概览里同一行的数字按同一高度对齐，不再因旁边格的脚注较长而下沉。关联 #13297。
  • 修复：同一个 Git 仓库下的多个项目互相等待写入时，提示现在说明它们共用该仓库这一个写入域，并给出出路。关联 #13335。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@kevin9327、@chuiwenwei

This release adds a session overview, updating skills from their source folder, update notifications, per-model prices and an optimistic sub-agent write mode, and fixes stuck Stop, background-job state, projects in one repository waiting on each other and compaction recovery.

New

  • "My feedback" gains an "Account link": once signed in, link this computer yourself and unlink any time. Off by default, changes no limits. Refs #13141.
  • New "Branch from the latest reply" in the session menu: a running conversation can branch from its latest finished reply, and older replies' branch buttons work mid-run. Refs #13177.
  • Added: the sidebar session menu now has Auto name, which generates and saves a title in one step without opening Rename first, refs #13195 fixed in #13199
  • Added: Settings › Conversation folding › Thinking gains "Folded, with first sentence", showing the first sentence after a folded thought (long ones end in …). Default unchanged. Refs #13212.
  • Added: a hosted Studio page left open across an upgrade now says it is not the latest build and offers a refresh, instead of failing with errors like n.filter, refs #13213 fixed in #13218
  • Added: deleting a conversation that has recovery copies now offers to delete the copies with it, instead of one by one, refs #13221 fixed in #13225
  • Added: the file window has an "open the project in another program" menu (VS Code, terminal and the other programs installed here), refs #13227
  • Added: built-in browser tabs can be renamed by double-clicking, instead of always showing the address, refs #13228 fixed in #13267
  • Added: on Windows, "point at an executable" takes launcher arguments (for example wsl.exe -d -- /bin/bash), verified by running them before saving. Refs #13247.
  • Added: the file window in the right sidebar has a "show this file in the system file manager" button in its toolbar, so you no longer need the file list right-click, refs #13255
  • Added: replies to feedback can carry screenshots (paste or pick, up to 3); they go to the maintainers only, who decide whether to make them public. Refs #13258.
  • Added: an isolated workspace copy can be created from a chosen branch, and an unknown branch is reported clearly. Refs #13271.
  • Added: an optimistic mode for sub-agent write scope in Settings (off by default): a sub-agent with no write_paths no longer holds the whole workspace. Refs #13274.
  • Added: the connection editor takes a per-model price (input, output, cache hit, currency); a model with no price still shows as unknown in usage. Refs #13276.
  • Added: Settings, Version, "Update mode". Manual (default) does nothing in the background; Notify checks daily and dots the Settings icon. Neither downloads, installs or restarts. Refs #13291.
  • Added: the cache figure under the composer opens a session overview: requests, tokens, cache hit, work time, cost, by source, each with its definition; incomplete cost shows a floor. Refs #13297.
  • Added: the session overview shows the context window: used, capacity, share by kind and the fold line, stated as a current reading, with a way into the context details. Refs #13297.
  • Added: the Skills list marks an installed skill copy that no longer matches the folder it came from: source changed, copy edited, both changed, or source gone. Refs #13311.
  • Added: a skill copied from a local folder can be updated from it in the Skills list: preview each file change (scripts must be opened), confirm; a failure keeps the old copy. Refs #13311.

Changed

  • The sidebar footer's "Send feedback" is now bold in the accent colour so it is easier to find (no animation; other feedback entries unchanged). Refs #13048.

items.summary: CLI archives built from the Studio release studio-v2.41.0. This release adds side questions, keeping a long paste as a file, optional session-row buttons and a sandbox device allowlist, and fixes narrow-window layout, contrast, memory recall and remote-control…
items.html:
CLI archives built from the Studio release studio-v2.41.0.

This release adds side questions, keeping a long paste as a file, optional session-row buttons and a sandbox device allowlist, and fixes narrow-window layout, contrast, memory recall and remote-control compatibility.

New

  • Settings → Model preferences gains an independent naming model and per-role reasoning effort, so titles can use their own model and each role its own effort. Refs #11851.
  • New side questions: ask a read-only question beside the main conversation; read-only tools, never in the main transcript, dropped on close. Refs #12927, #13128.
  • Each class in the context details can be opened to its largest items (sizes and tool names only, never message text). Refs #13052, #13143.
  • When an MCP server puts ttlMs on its tool list, the catalog is re-read once it runs out (clamped to 30 s to 1 h) instead of relying on change notices alone. Refs #13108.
  • A skill's allowed-tools now also takes the open-standard spelling (space separated, like Bash(git add:*) Read); commas still work. Refs #13110.
  • reasonix doctor now reports skill names and descriptions that depart from the Agent Skills spec (uppercase, hyphens, length, directory mismatch); such skills still load. Refs #13110.
  • Settings → Appearance gains "Session row buttons": when on, hovering a sidebar session row shows Archive and Delete; off by default, both stay in the context menu. Refs #13132.
  • When compaction rejects its candidate as too large, the message now splits it into fixed prefix, protected messages, summary and recent tail, not just "still above trigger". Refs #13148.
  • The feedback dialog gains an "Ideas and discussion" link to GitHub Discussions for suggestions; bugs and errors still use Send. Refs #13141, #13155.
  • New [sandbox] allow_devices: the Linux command sandbox hides host devices such as the GPU; a user-level allowlist binds them in. Off by default; project config cannot set it. Refs #13157.
  • The long-paste chip gains "save as file": on click the text is stored as a file and the message carries only a pointer (lines, size, path, how to read it); never automatic. Refs #13148, #13162.
  • In the terminal, a folded long paste can be kept as a file with Ctrl+G: the message carries a pointer, not the text; without the key it is sent whole as before. Refs #13148, #13166.

Changed

  • ACP tool-call updates now name the invoked tool. Refs #13114, #13130.
  • On Linux, bubblewrap installed but unable to create a namespace (containers, hardened kernels) now gets its real cause and ways out, not "install it". Refs #13117, #13138, #13146.
  • Compaction now refuses up front when the protected messages and recent tail already reach the trigger, naming what holds the size, instead of paying for a summary that cannot fit. Refs #13148.

Fixed

  • A recalled memory fact edited or deleted outside the session is re-read before the next recall (only the last hits are checked, no full scan). Refs #12948.
  • Unreadable memory directories now report errors, keeping revision lists, restores, and recovery from treating permission or storage failures as missing data. Refs #12950.
  • On Linux, a launch folder nobody picked and nothing was said in is no longer listed as a project, so deleting it does not bring it back on restart. Refs #13107, #13127.
  • A requested file that does not exist is now said so in the side panel instead of opening a blank preview page. Refs #13125, #13133.
  • With a wallpaper set, the sidebar footer no longer paints a whiter plate; the picture continues to the bottom. Refs #13129, #13131.
  • On a phone browser too old for X25519 in WebCrypto, remote control now falls back to an audited software curve, loaded only then (about 24 KB), instead of asking for a newer browser. Refs #13140.
  • When an older session cannot be opened after a restart, the error now says why: the file is gone, its folder is gone, or the system could not read the path (with its reason). Refs #13152, #13159.
  • Narrow windows no longer overlap or squeeze: the tab bar wraps, settings labels keep their width, segmented controls stay in the sheet, and a few colours reach AA. Refs #13169.
  • Narrow windows: activity step rows keep their duration and arrow, the meter rail's subagent chip keeps its count when it cannot fit, and config error paths wrap. Refs #13154, #13172.
  • Fixed two contrast shortfalls: the intro "press any key to skip" hint and the +/− counts in the changed-files pill (both themes). Found by the audit at f8c262da0.

items.html:
本版本新增辅助会话、按需保存长粘贴、会话行快捷按钮、沙盒设备白名单等功能，并修复窄窗口布局、对比度、记忆召回和远控兼容等一批问题。

新增

  • 设置 → 模型偏好新增「命名模型」和按角色的推理强度：可以单独指定用哪个模型给会话起标题，并分别设置各角色的推理强度。关联 #11851 by @Guan0923。
  • 新增「辅助会话」：在主对话旁边问一个只读的小问题，用只读工具回答，不写进主对话、不改文件，关闭即丢弃。关联 #12927 fixed in #13128、#13128。
  • 上下文详情里每一类占用可以展开，看最大的几项（只显示大小和工具名，不含消息内容）。关联 #13052、#13143。
  • MCP 服务器在工具列表响应里给出 ttlMs 时，工具目录会在到期后自动重读（限制在 30 秒到 1 小时之间），不再只靠变更通知。关联 #13108。
  • 技能的 allowed-tools 现在也接受开放标准写法（空格分隔，如 Bash(git add:*) Read），原来的逗号分隔照常可用；括号内的分隔符属于同一条规则。关联 #13110。
  • reasonix doctor 现在会提示技能的名称、描述不符合 Agent Skills 开放标准（大写、连字符、超长、与目录名不一致），这些技能仍会正常加载。关联 #13110。
  • 设置 → 外观新增「会话行快捷按钮」：打开后，鼠标移到侧栏会话行上会显示「归档」「删除」按钮；默认关闭，两个操作仍在右键菜单里。关联 #13132。
  • 压缩被拒时，提示现在列出候选内容的构成（固定前缀、被保护的消息、摘要、最近回合各占多少），不再只说「候选仍高于触发线」。关联 #13148。
  • 反馈对话框新增「想法与讨论」入口，建议和想法可以发到 GitHub 讨论区，bug 和错误仍用发送。关联 #13141、#13155。
  • 新增 [sandbox] allow_devices：Linux 命令沙盒默认看不到宿主的设备节点（如显卡），现在可在用户级配置里用 /dev/nvidia* 这类白名单放进去；默认关闭，项目配置不能开。关联 #13157。
  • 撰写框里的长粘贴芯片新增「存为文件」：点了才把这段文字存成文件，消息里只带一段指针（行数、大小、路径、怎么读），原文不再随每个请求发送；不会自动存。关联 #13148、#13162。
  • 终端界面里折叠的长粘贴可以按 Ctrl+G 存成文件：发送时只带一段指针，不再把原文送给模型；不按就和以前一样整段发送。关联 #13148、#13166。

变更

  • ACP 的工具调用更新现在带上被调用的工具名。关联 #13114、#13130。
  • Linux 上 bubblewrap 已安装却不能创建命名空间（容器、受限内核）时，提示不再说「请安装」，而是说明真实原因和出路。关联 #13117、#13138、#13146。
  • 压缩前先预判：被保护的消息和最近回合本身就已超过触发线、摘要无论怎样都放不进去时，直接拒绝并说明构成，不再先花一次摘要调用。关联 #13148。

修复

  • 会话里召回过的记忆在会话外被修改或删除后，下一次召回会读到新内容（只重查上次命中的几条，不全量扫描）。关联 #12948 fixed in #13147。
  • 记忆目录因权限或存储故障无法读取时，现在明确报错，避免漏列历史版本、误报版本不存在，或根据不完整历史计算恢复版本号。关联 #12950 fixed in #13016 by @SivanCola。
  • Linux 上启动时不再把没人选过、也没说过话的启动目录（主目录）列成项目，删掉它重启后不会再回来。关联 #13107 fixed in #13127、#13127。
  • 要打开的文件不存在时，右侧面板现在明确提示「找不到该文件」，不再打开一片空白的预览页。关联 #13125、#13133。
  • 设置壁纸后，侧栏底部（钱包与用量、发送反馈、账号）不再多出一块发白的底，壁纸一直延续到最下面。关联 #13129、#13131。
  • 手机浏览器版本太旧、没有 X25519 加密时，远控现在改用经审计的软件实现继续连接（只在需要时才加载，约 24 KB），不再要求换浏览器。关联 #13140。
  • 重启后点以前的会话打不开时，提示现在区分原因：会话文件已不在、会话所在目录不在、或系统读不了该路径（并带上系统给的原因），不再一律说「无法解析该会话路径」。关联 #13152、#13159。
  • 窄窗口下界面不再重叠或被挤压：标签栏会换行，设置里的标签不再被压成一字一行，分段控件不再跑出面板，几处文字对比度提高到 AA。关联 #13169。
  • 窄窗口下的排版修正：活动步骤行的耗时与箭头不再被挤出，计量栏的子代理芯片收起文字保留数字，配置错误框的路径改为换行。关联 #13154、#13172。
  • 修复两处对比度不达 AA：开场页的「按任意键跳过」提示，和输入框上方「已更改文件」胶囊里的 +/− 数字（深浅两种主题）。整机审查于 f8c262da0。

感谢本版本的贡献者：@Guan0923、@SivanCola

items.html:
CLI archives built from the Studio release studio-v2.40.0.

This release fixes the unclickable workspace "+" button, adds a turn-narration setting, and lets the changelog switch between Chinese and English.

New

  • The feedback dialog gains "Capture this window": it takes one picture of the app window only when you click, adds it as a removable thumbnail, and never sends it on its own. Refs #11965.
  • The session tree now carries each conversation's last-activity time, so a list can sort by recency or show a relative time. Refs #12011.
  • A sub-agent queued behind another's write claim now says whose claim it waits on, and whether neither declared write_paths (each treated as writing the whole workspace). Refs #12052.
  • Theme packs gain shadowFloat, the shadow menus, popovers and dialogs cast; unset keeps the built-in one. Refs #12063.
  • Charts now write each value beside its bar or line point while the plot is sparse, and draw none when there are too many marks to read; hover readout is unchanged. Refs #12291.
  • Projects in the sidebar can now be reordered by dragging a row; a line on the target's top or bottom edge shows where it lands, and the order is kept by the kernel. Refs #12300.
  • The "Worked for" line at the end of a turn now also says when the turn began (time of day for today, with the date for another day), and it survives reopening the session. Refs #12728.
  • Settings > Account gains "Export and import config": no account needed; export an encrypted file and import it item by item elsewhere. Keys off by default; a passphrase is required. Refs #12736.
  • Settings → Session gains "Narration between tool calls": Detailed asks the model for three or four lines between batches of tool calls; Brief, the default, changes nothing. Refs #12788.
  • The project menu gains "Open with …": besides the file manager, open a project folder in the VS Code, Cursor, IntelliJ IDEA or system terminal this machine has installed. Refs #12858.
  • The workbench explorer gains a "Commit history" section: opened, it lists the newest commits of every branch as a graph, with branches and tags. Refs #12913.
  • Settings → Appearance gains a "Sessions from 1.x" switch to hide migrated 1.x sessions from the sidebar; shown by default, nothing is deleted. Refs #12964.
  • In the terminal UI, /theme now opens a picker that previews each row as you move, keeps it on Enter and restores the original on Esc; /theme list still prints the names. Refs #12985.
  • When the context is over the compaction threshold with nothing to fold, a notice now says what holds the tokens, by class and largest items. Refs #13013.
  • Local stdio MCP servers now receive the extra folders you allowed tools to write in _meta["io.reasonix/writableRoots"]; remote ones do not. Refs #13053.
  • First-run setup gains "Not now": open the workbench first, with a note above the input box leading back to setup; this launch only, offered again next time. Refs #13065.
  • The bottom "Generation speed" detail gains "Time to first token" (request sent to first output, timed by the kernel) and now uses the same row layout as the context detail. Refs #13075.
  • Adding a project now selects it and opens a new session in it (nothing is sent for you), whether through "Open or create project", the first-run prompt or a folder drop. Refs #13076.
  • New floating "Back to top" / "Jump to latest" buttons in the conversation (hidden near an end or when nothing scrolls) land on the nearest expanded block first. Refs #13077.
  • The Versions page can switch a release's notes between Chinese and English, following the interface language by default; every release's notes now carry English. Refs #13081.

Changed

  • The Files button in the rail and sidebar now toggles: pressed while the files panel is open it folds it, and it reopens after the panel was closed elsewhere. Refs #12925.
  • The composer's model menu now sets provider headings apart, indents the models, and adds multi-select provider chips that are remembered. Refs #12926.
  • Restore the black-and-gold application, taskbar/Dock, launcher and tray icons. Refs #13004.
  • Sent pictures, pictures waiting in the composer and tool screenshots share one viewer: open the original, Esc to leave, focus returns. Refs #13006, #13010.
  • The Settings sidebar's selected row no longer carries the accent colour, outline and edge bar, only a deeper fill; section titles are lighter than the items under them. Refs #13045, #13046.
  • The title-bar Browser button is gone: the Workbench tab is the one way in, and with nothing running it shows the Files / Changes / Browser start page instead of opening a blank page. Refs #13067.
  • Session rows no longer show the hover Archive and Delete icons; both stay in the right-click menu, and the Delete key still works. Refs #13068.

Fixed

  • When the model cannot draft a commit message, the commit card still lists the staged files and says why; type the message and commit. Refs #12747.
  • The context gauge now reads the provider's reported size plus what grew since, instead of the larger of that and the local estimate, so an estimate running high no longer inflates it. Refs #12988.
  • A read-only find ... -exec wc/grep/cat/stat ... is no longer treated as a write, so it does not claim the workspace write lease or collide with another session's edit. Refs #12993.
  • The repeated-output guard now also flags a stream that collapses to a few tiny lines in no fixed order; before it only saw byte-identical loops. Refs #13001.
  • Each sub-agent in the sub-agents popover now shows its own task title (the first line of its description, cut to fit, full text on hover), so parallel ones no longer all read "task". Refs #13002.
  • Switching to a long session no longer shows "could not restore extension surfaces"; you hear once only if a surface was dropped. Refs #13011.
  • On the run-analysis signal rail, marks too close together now share one counted marker that opens a list, instead of stacking into a tall column. Refs #13034.
  • Fixed the project row's "…" button answering only at its corners: the faded count badge kept sitting over it and taking the click; it no longer takes the pointer. Refs #13036, #13038.
  • The magnifier beside the session filters is now a real toggle: pressing it again closes the find box instead of replaying its opening animation. Refs #13041.
  • The "+" that opens or creates a project folder on the sidebar's "This machine" row is now always visible instead of appearing only when the row is hovered. Refs #13043, #13072.
  • Fixed the branch hover card staying on screen under the branch menu and stacking a second shadow. Refs #13044.
  • The red notice raised when reading the session status fails on reload now clears itself when that read next succeeds, instead of waiting for "Got it". Refs #13047.
  • Failures that do not block sending now show as corner notices (three at most, dismissed only by you) with "Report this problem". Refs #13047, #13048.
  • The extension-surface, MCP catalog and changed-files reads treat a missing list as empty instead of raising "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')". Refs #13055.
  • The branch list, event replay and queue now answer an empty list instead of null when they are empty, so the page no longer fails reading them. Refs #13055.
  • The "Report this problem" entry on error bars and corner notices now also writes a page defect's error name and where it came from (file name and line only) into the feedback draft. Refs #13055.
  • A red notice under the composer that comes from a defect of the page itself (for example "Cannot read properties of undefined") now also logs its stack to the console. Refs #13055.
  • Uploading a large image or file from the phone remote page no longer drops the connection: an oversized request is refused on the phone with a clear message and the link keeps working. Refs #13056.
  • The phone remote page can now upload larger images and files, sent as several messages and handled once the desktop has them all (up to 16 MB). Refs #13056.
  • Fixed the repeated "Checkpoint recording failed" warning for writes outside the workspace, such as the session temp folder: they are now a coverage gap, not a failure. Refs #13060.
  • Fixed the kernel crashing when an MCP server fails to launch or reconnect: a failed server now only becomes unavailable, nothing else is affected. Refs #13086.

items.html:
Highlights

  • Workspace groups — select sidebar workspaces and press ⌘⇧G to group them under a collapsible header, with an anchor workspace, drag-to-group, in-group reorder, per-group color/icon, header unread badges, and a cmux workspace-group CLI namespace.
  • Focus & Recently Closed history — navigate back/forward through recently focused workspaces and windows from the titlebar, and reopen closed surfaces from a searchable history pane.
  • Agent Hibernation — pause idle agent sessions and restore them on demand to cut background resource use.
  • Detachable SSH PTY daemon — keeps remote sessions alive across reconnects.
  • Configurable sidebar and tab bar font sizes, redesigned notifications popover (swipe to dismiss), browser tab mute, Fork Conversation menu, Xcode-style project visualizer pane, and a cmux diff CodeView viewer.
  • Fixes across file preview, Hermes hooks, split zoom, titlebar controls, Vault resume, and equalize splits.

items.summary: What's in v0.10.2 Codewhale v0.10.2 adds an animated pet view (/pet on), a live Terminal work dock, per-chat composer colors (/color) and a one-time note on the first start after an update that says what changed. It closes three session data-loss paths and a…
items.html:
What's in v0.10.2

Codewhale v0.10.2 adds an animated pet view (/pet on), a live Terminal work dock, per-chat composer colors (/color) and a one-time note on the first start after an update that says what changed. It closes three session data-loss paths and a codewhale web session leak; adds the default Runtime daemon socket locations to the sandbox deny-list; holds a curl or wget that uploads a credential; refuses shell commands containing invisible Unicode; keeps the Linux sandbox working when a hidden credential directory is a symlink; and reduces idle TUI redraw work. /undo takes back a whole request, including long and multiline prompts. exec --auto explains its Full Access default, honors an explicitly stricter sandbox, and saves tool-enabled runs and their failure receipts. Local runtimes appear during onboarding, /diff works outside a Git repository, DeepSeek's Responses route no longer rejects replayed tool history, and contributor fixes improve token accounting, relay model lists, localized replies and Windows launcher guidance. Delegated work continues without model-invented turn or time caps, and independent workflow steps can continue after another child fails.

Install

Recommended — official GitHub release

New macOS/Linux install (checksummed binaries from this release):

curl -fsSL https://codewhale.net/install.sh | CODEWHALE_VERSION="v0.10.2" sh
"$HOME/.local/bin/codewhale" --version

For Windows, use the matching installer or archive below. For an existing direct install, run codewhale update; it prints the executable path and keeps newer builds. If the install directory is occupied by a different build, use the fresh-directory migration in the installation guide.

Secondary packaging — npm and Cargo
npm install -g codewhale
# or build from source
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked

The wrapper downloads the matched codewhale and codew command assets from this Release. Both contain the same compiled runtime.

Docker / GHCR
docker run --rm -it \
  -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" \
  -v codewhale-home:/home/codewhale/.codewhale \
  ghcr.io/codewhale-hq/codewhale:v0.10.2

The image exposes the same runtime as both codewhale and codew. The latest tag is also updated on release.

Cargo (Linux / macOS)
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked

The Cargo package installs codewhale. Cargo cannot create a second command alias from one binary target; users who want the shorter spelling can add a codew symlink to that installed executable. The npm, Homebrew, archive, shell-installer, and container channels install both command names directly.

Manual download — platform archives (recommended)

Each archive below contains the same runtime under the codewhale and codew command names, plus an install script:

Platform Archive Install script
Linux x64 codewhale-linux-x64.tar.gz install.sh
Linux ARM64 codewhale-linux-arm64.tar.gz install.sh
Android ARM64 (Termux) codewhale-android-arm64.tar.gz install.sh
macOS x64 codewhale-macos-x64.tar.gz install.sh
macOS ARM codewhale-macos-arm64.tar.gz install.sh
Windows x64 (installer) CodeWhaleSetup.exe NSIS setup
Windows x64 codewhale-windows-x64.zip install.bat
Windows x64 (portable) codewhale-windows-x64-portable.zip —
Windows ARM64 codewhale-windows-arm64.zip install.bat
Windows ARM64 (portable) codewhale-windows-arm64-portable.zip —

Unix (Linux / macOS):

tar xzf codewhale-<platform>.tar.gz
cd codewhale-<platform>
./install.sh

Windows:

  • For the installer path, run CodeWhaleSetup.exe; it installs codewhale.exe, codew.exe, and codewhale.bat under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\CodeWhale\bin, adds that directory to the current-user PATH, and creates a Start Menu shortcut that prefers Windows Terminal (wt.exe) when it is installed.
  • Extract the archive for your machine: codewhale-windows-x64.zip or codewhale-windows-arm64.zip
  • Double-click codewhale.bat (not the raw .exe) to launch
  • Run install.bat to copy the binaries and launcher to %USERPROFILE%\bin
  • Add %USERPROFILE%\bin to your PATH

The portable Windows archive skips the install script — extract and run codewhale.bat from any directory. The NSIS installer is currently unsigned and may trigger Windows SmartScreen until a signing certificate is wired into the release pipeline.

Each platform also has bare, unarchived codewhale-<platform> and codew-<platform> assets. The seven codewhale-tui-<platform> filenames attached to v0.9.5 are byte-identical compatibility copies used only to let already-installed v0.9.4 clients discover and cross this single-binary transition; current installers do not expose a third runtime. The legacy npm package deepseek-tui is deprecated and is not republished. For migration from v0.8.x legacy binary names, see docs/REBRAND.md.

Verify (recommended)

Download the checksum manifests from this Release and verify:

# Linux — archive bundles
sha256sum -c codewhale-bundles-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

# Linux — individual binaries
sha256sum -c codewhale-artifacts-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

# macOS
shasum -a 256 -c codewhale-bundles-sha256.txt --ignore-missing
shasum -a 256 -c codewhale-artifacts-sha256.txt --ignore-missing
Full release notes

The full notes exceed GitHub's release-description limit. Read the complete changelog for v0.10.2.

Contributors

  • Dhruv Singal / @dsingal0 — added Herdr agent state, session resume commands and pane release (#7064).
  • @shenjackyuanjie — diagnosed and fixed the Windows OpenHarmony CMake generator and CLI hashing-module build failures (#6988, #6989).
  • @printf033 — replaced the SELinux-denied root-directory anchor of confined-file I/O with an O_PATH walk (Linux-cfg-gated) and a re-materialized final parent, restoring workflow journal, compaction checkpoint and artifact writes on Android/Termux (#6983); reported the Android confined-I/O failure with strace evidence and an on-device reproducer (#6980). Source change; compiled Android and device acceptance remain unqualified.
  • @aboimpinto — moved config-command parsing and replies onto portable contracts while the host retains effects (#6973).
  • @henrikdukefoss — added the Standard Compute compatible-host descriptor, with live model discovery and its billing basis kept Unknown (#6985).
  • @LIghtJUNction

What's in v0.10.0

Codewhale v0.10.0 brings a redesigned terminal workbench, clearer settings, and more reliable session and runtime behavior. It supersedes the unpublished v0.9.14 candidate.

Security

  • Children never inherit desktop or computer-control tools. Desktop control is the most machine-wide capability in the catalog, and a verifier child inherited it by default: on 2026-09-17 one opened the host Terminal and typed a blocked shell command into the user's live session. A family classifier now removes those tools when a child's registry is built, so they are neither eager nor searchable, and execute_full refuses the family at dispatch for every child role — visibility is a grant, and hiding is not the only defense (#6296).

  • Runtimes can be held to an organization's plugin allowlist. A managed policy document (managed-policy.json beside state.json, or CODEWHALE_MANAGED_POLICY_PATH) lists the plugin ids a Runtime may run, with an allow_unlisted flag and a schema version checked exactly like PluginStateFile. Enforcement sits inside apply_state, so a plugin enabled before the policy arrived — or hand-edited to enabled: true — never comes back enabled, and enable() re-reads the document so a policy landing after discovery refuses with a reason that names it. A malformed document fails closed rather than degrading to unenforced. With no policy present, behaviour is bit-for-bit what it was. This is the enforcement primitive only; the authority that decides the allowlist is still local, so it binds a cooperating Runtime, not a hostile one.

  • Approving an apply_patch "for the session" is now scoped to the file you approved. The grouping key that scopes a session grant was built by a second, weaker patch parser that read only +++ b/ headers and the replace array: it saw no target at all for the documented apply_patch{path, patch} override, for --no-prefix diffs, or for delete-only diffs, and collapsed every one of them to a single shared key. One approval therefore pre-approved every later patch of that shape, to any file, with no card and no notice. The key now comes from the same resolver the executor and the permission path already use, and an input that cannot be resolved gets its own key rather than a shared one (#6247).

Added

  • The statusline's performance readings survive compact mode and are separately configurable. Measured TTFT and average output rate are kept when space allows, shedding help text and secondary counts first; the existing metrics and statusline settings gain individual toggles with a migration that preserves a legacy single setting, and the picker takes mouse selection and scrolling.

  • Tasks can be given their own run name. NewTaskRequest, TaskRecord

Fixed

  • The website's Computer Use download page resolves its state without the GitHub API (using GITHUB_TOKEN only when bound), and every page regenerates on the Worker again: the Open Graph image route read brand SVGs at import time, which the Workers runtime cannot do, so codewhale.net had been serving its build-time snapshot.

  • Operate can run structured workflows directly, with named phases, model assignments from Fleet, prerequisite results and shared budgets. Independent steps run together; dependent work waits for its required results and gates. Detached runs return their outcome to the owning conversation, and headless sessions stay alive between phases until the final handback is consumed.

  • Cloud dispatch: remote runner offloads coding agent tasks to isolated cloud sandboxes with machine token auth and structured job tracking (#5701, #5712).
  • Per-session control socket: config-gated [control_socket] table binds <sessions-dir>/<session-id>/control.sock per running session, exposing message, interrupt, relaunch, and status JSON-RPC verbs (#5533, #5831).
Changed

  • Anonymous usage counting is on by default. The 0.9.11 release asked first; 0.9.12 counts the same aggregate version/platform, session, feature and error totals unless you turn it off, and says so once at first launch (policy notice version 5, schema 3, notice_version replacing consent_version). Every recorded opt-out stays off: a durable telemetry = false, a decline recorded under the old opt-in notice, unreadable privacy state, and the CODEWHALE_TELEMETRY=0 / --telemetry false kill switches. Showing the disclosure records only that it was shown, never an acceptance. codewhale config set telemetry false turns it off and wipes queued counts; codewhale config set telemetry true

What's in v0.9.10

  • Show the full slash-command or /model completion row in a bounded, wrapping hover popover whenever narrow terminals truncate it, closing the remaining scoped gap from #998. Thanks @AiurArtanis and @formp3 for identifying the affected surfaces.
  • registry_sync no longer ships the full MCP Registry catalog into the conversation. It takes a required query, scores the local snapshot host-side, and returns at most eight matches; the complete catalog stays on disk, and the compaction and spillover exemptions that let a multi-hundred- kilobyte dump reach the model unchanged are gone.
  • Providers that mirror the outgoing (reasoning omitted) replay placeholder back as a reasoning delta no longer have that echo ingested as real thinking: the exact transport placeholder is dropped on arrival, so live sessions stop showing a stream of placeholder reasoning blocks and saved transcripts stay free of them.
  • Mid-stream connection drops during an interactive turn no longer persist a synthetic [runtime] user message. Retry state is a typed engine-internal descriptor; a thinking-only drop re-issues the request without claiming a partial reply was preserved, the retry budget is enforced in mechanism, and recovery produces exactly one authoritative final answer.

Codewhale v0.9.10 is a retention, identity, and product-clarity release: the shell and transcript can no longer retain unbounded tool output in memory or on disk, mid-turn history inserts no longer strand in-flight tool rows, every agent that ran this session is visible from /agents list, the PTY acceptance lane has a stall watchdog and bounded CI steps, approval outcomes are durable and fail closed (cyq1017, #5360), and three $HOME disk leaks are reclaimed. Extension surfaces now name their real state and act only through the reviewed install and trust flows, and sub-agent, shell, task, and workflow state is owned by the session that created it (#5518). Test threads get an 8 MiB stack so the lib suite can no longer abort under load.

  • A foreground bash command that named no timeout is bounded again. The model-facing bash tool left an omitted timeout_ms at the internal ceiling (~24.8 days) instead of the 120 s default its own schema advertises, so a CLI that blocked on an interactive prompt or a hung network call held the turn open indefinitely — one report sat on a single unauthenticated CLI call for over two hours with the tool row simply counting seconds. The advertised default now applies, which arms the existing recovery: the process is killed and the model is told to rerun with background=true and poll with action="wait". An explicit timeout_ms is still honored for genuinely long foreground work, and background and interactive runs keep their own lifetimes.

What's in v0.9.9

  • A concrete route/offering output limit now outranks the conservative 8,192-token compatibility guess for an uncatalogued model. Routes that publish no output limit remain fail-closed, documented model ceilings stay authoritative, and a route limit can never raise the requested cap (#5460).
  • Context-window honesty at every surface (#5239, #5441): the model-name hint and fallback rungs of the context-window ladder are guesses, and every surface that renders one now says so — the status line, /status, /config, the context-pressure message, the model picker chips, and the auto-router inventory. Unverified windows still drive real budgets (compaction trigger, context meter, output reservation); they just stop reading as capabilities anyone checked. A window parsed from an _Nk model-name suffix (qwen3-32b-256k → 256K) is now its own model-name hint rung below catalog, because it is optimistic rather than conservative — a catalog or provider-reported value beats it. The [providers.<name>] context_window override remains the hard fix and renders as configured with no marker.
  • Output-ceiling honesty (#5440): an Anthropic-family model the catalog does not describe keeps the 64K Messages floor as its clamp and the ChatGPT/ Codex OAuth route keeps its 4K policy, but OutputCeilingSource gained an unverified rung for both, so exec-stream receipts and the model picker label them unverified/"assumed floor" instead of documented. Clamp values are unchanged.
  • Telemetry default-on is visible (#5441): codewhale doctor's runtime-posture section gained a telemetry=on (default)-style row with the source that decided it (cli | env | config | default), and codewhale config get telemetry reports the resolved consent with its source instead of key not found on a machine whose batches ship. Truth change only; resolution and behavior are untouched.
  • Fleet: a scout's read-only shell carve-out (#5428) is now honored by both the posture gate and the execution envelope, so git log, find | head, npm view and the other bounded read-only commands run in-place instead of being refused as "Executes" (#5426). Delegation still never widens authority: the role-isolation test and docs/SUBAGENTS.md pin that a child cannot exceed its parent's posture (#5426, #5435).

What's in v0.9.8

Fixed

  • sudo (and su/setuid helpers) work again for wheel-group administrators who want Codewhale to be able to escalate: the Linux startup hardening's irreversible PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS flag — inherited by every child process — is now skippable with CODEWHALE_NO_NEW_PRIVS=0 (#5413). The flag stays on by default; the no-ptrace and no-core-dump measures are never skipped.

  • Abort-class process deaths no longer poison the terminal (#5424). A stack overflow, allocation failure, or double panic skips the panic hook and every cleanup guard, which is how a v0.9.7 user's mid-turn exit left mouse capture leaking SGR sequences into their shell. The tool loop no longer recomposes the system prompt from disk on every model step, so an agent writing a file no longer busts the provider KV prefix cache mid-turn. The system prompt and tool catalog are re-composed only on a declared header change (/model, mode, goal, session resume), which re-pins under a logged reason; an undeclared change is reported as drift and the original pin is kept instead of silently becoming the new baseline. Workspace, AGENTS.md, skills, memory, and goal drift now reaches the model as one bounded <context_update> user message at the next user turn — a history append, not a header rewrite. /cache stats shows the pin reason, the last-miss reason, the undeclared-drift count, and the context-update count. See docs/CACHE.md.

  • Plugin compatibility is now per-component. A reviewed, trusted, enabled bundle that mixes Skills or MCP with unsupported commands, agents, hooks, LSP, native, filesystem-roots, or lifecycle-mutation declarations keeps the supported adapters active and reports the rest as inactive (full / partial / unsupported). All-unsupported bundles still cannot be enabled. The capability hash is now v2 and binds this build's activation policy, so older v1 receipts and any later adapter-enablement change fail closed as needs-review. Skills and each MCP transport re-request their own capability at the consumption boundary.

Added

  • Composer multiline mode is available in /settings. When enabled, Enter inserts a new line and Shift+Enter sends the message (#5345, reported and tracked by @AiurArtanis).

  • /plugin marketplace add|list|show|remove|install completes the federated marketplace journey (#5311). add reads one LOCAL catalog document in the real published schemas (Kimi, Claude, Codex, or Codewhale native) — no network, regular files only — and persists it beside the plugin state with the same hardened, fail-closed store. list/show render every candidate with per-entry diagnostics, display-only tiers, and honest install plans that say when Codewhale cannot fetch a source; install routes through the existing reviewed installer, so installed bundles still enter disabled and untrusted. Foreign auto-install policy (Codex INSTALLED_BY_DEFAULT) is visibly ignored; nothing is auto-installed, auto-trusted, or granted vendor trust.

  • /rc attach now includes an observed owner/name

Its 500K context, text/image input, tool and structured-output support, low/medium/high/xhigh reasoning efforts (default high), and server-side web search all come from the Models.dev-shaped catalog rather than model-specific code. reasoning_effort reaches the wire only on the exact first-party https://api.x.ai/v1 route, and the usage-aware 200K-token pricing boundary is scoped to direct xAI so aggregator routes reusing the model slug cannot inherit xAI billing.
  • OrcaRouter is a first-class named provider: ORCAROUTER_API_KEY, default base URL https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1, deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro default, orcarouter/auto routing, CLI --provider selector, and TUI picker entries (#5321).
Changed

Fixed

Codewhale is the public product from Shannon Labs. The codewhale command, npm package, and release-asset names remain lowercase technical identifiers. The legacy npm package deepseek-tui is deprecated and receives no further releases. Users coming from v0.8.x legacy deepseek / deepseek-tui names should migrate with docs/REBRAND.md.

Install

Recommended — npm (one command, both entrypoints)
npm install -g codewhale

The wrapper downloads the matched codewhale and codew command assets from this Release. Both contain the same compiled runtime.

Docker / GHCR
docker run --rm -it \
  -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" \
  -v codewhale-home:/home/codewhale/.codewhale \
  ghcr.io/hmbown/codewhale:v0.9.6

The image exposes the same runtime as both codewhale and codew. The latest tag is also updated on release.

Cargo (Linux / macOS)
cargo install codewhale-cli --locked

The Cargo package installs codewhale. Cargo cannot create a second command alias from one binary target; users who want the shorter spelling can add a codew symlink to that installed executable. The npm, Homebrew, archive, shell-installer, and container channels install both command names directly.

Manual download — platform archives (recommended)

Each archive below contains the same runtime under the codewhale and codew command names, plus an install script:

Platform Archive Install script
Linux x64 codewhale-linux-x64.tar.gz install.sh
Linux ARM64 codewhale-linux-arm64.tar.gz install.sh
Android ARM64 (Termux) codewhale-android-arm64.tar.gz install.sh
macOS x64 codewhale-macos-x64.tar.gz install.sh
macOS ARM codewhale-macos-arm64.tar.gz install.sh
Windows x64 (installer) CodeWhaleSetup.exe NSIS setup
Windows x64 codewhale-windows-x64.zip install.bat
Windows x64 (portable) codewhale-windows-x64-portable.zip —
Windows ARM64 codewhale-windows-arm64.zip install.bat
Windows ARM64 (portable) codewhale-windows-arm64-portable.zip —

Unix (Linux / macOS):

tar xzf codewhale-<platform>.tar.gz
cd codewhale-<platform>
./install.sh

Windows:

  • For the installer path, run CodeWhaleSetup.exe; it installs codewhale.exe and codew.exe under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\CodeWhale\bin and adds that directory to the current-user PATH.
  • Extract the archive for your machine: codewhale-windows-x64.zip or codewhale-windows-arm64.zip
  • Run install.bat (copies to %USERPROFILE%\bin)
  • Add %USERPROFILE%\bin to your PATH

The portable Windows archive skips the install script — extract and run from any directory. The NSIS installer is currently unsigned and may trigger Windows SmartScreen until a signing certificate is wired into the release pipeline.

Each platform also has bare, unarchived codewhale-<platform> and codew-<platform> assets. The seven codewhale-tui-<platform> filenames attached to v0.9.5 are byte-identical compatibility copies used only to let already-installed v0.9.4 clients discover and cross this single-binary transition; current installers do not expose a third runtime. The legacy npm package deepseek-tui is deprecated and is not republished. For migration from v0.8.x legacy binary names, see docs/REBRAND.md.

Verify (recommended)

Download the checksum manifests from this Release and verify:

# Linux — archive bundles
sha256sum -c codewhale-bundles-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

# Linux — individual binaries
sha256sum -c codewhale-artifacts-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

# macOS
shasum -a 256 -c codewhale-bundles-sha256.txt --ignore-missing
shasum -a 256 -c codewhale-artifacts-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

What's in v0.9.6

Codewhale v0.9.6 is a subtractive release: fewer runtime guards, one stable prompt, truthful provider endings, and a smaller compaction path that preserves the provider cache. The changes were grounded by matched Terminal-Bench 2.1 runs against Pi 0.8.41 and by dogfooding repeated manual compaction.

Added
  • web_search defaults to Firecrawl Cloud without an API key; keyless requests are headerless and quota-bounded, while an optional user key raises limits.
  • Green web builds on main now emit an actionable manual-deploy reminder, so site changes cannot quietly appear shipped while Cloudflare still serves an older revision.
  • Mistral AI is a first-class provider route, including Codestral models, first-party reasoning support, authentication, picker entries, and aliases.
  • Headless Bash can transfer explicitly requested persistent Unix services out of an exec run, with ownership and cleanup receipts.
  • /remote-env opens hosted Work from the current GitHub or CNB branch tip and states exactly which unpushed, dirty, ignored, secret, and session state stays local.
  • Linux ARM64 release and nightly assets are static musl builds with native launch checks.
  • Maintainers can report observed daily active installs from the same anonymous, aggregate telemetry dataset; no additional client data is collected.
  • Fleet-dispatched members under a read-only evidence (no-network) ceiling now keep the Web tool's read-only search and fetch actions — parity with an ordinary scout — while every reaching surface (web.run, fetch_url, github, MCP) stays denied and the sentinel-backed capability envelope remains the fail-closed backstop.
  • /fleet setup can show an optional, deterministic, unratified role-to-model advisory built only from configured ready routes. Accept, edit, and reject all remain inside the existing human-reviewed profile save boundary; the advisory never launches a Fleet or writes a second configuration.
  • /update checks for a newer Codewhale release and installs it from inside the TUI, while tui_help gives agents the same command and key map users see.
  • Markdown file paths render as OSC 8 links where the terminal supports them, and every agent row can open that agent's transcript directly.
  • ACP editor sessions can execute multi-round file, search, Git, patch, and explicitly enabled shell tool calls through the shared Runtime registry. Shell access requires both the client's terminal capability and Codewhale's headless shell opt-in, and cancellation stops an in-flight tool before the turn returns (#5225 by @rafaelcavalheri).
  • Lowercase read returns bounded typed PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP results to image-capable Chat, Responses, Anthropic, and ACP routes. Text-only routes receive an explicit omission receipt; image bytes never spill into ordinary transcript, export, compaction, or relay text.
Changed
  • Anonymous usage counting is on by default for fresh installs and disclosed in a native first-run Codewhale modal with an immediate opt-out. Prior declines remain off. Codewhale does not collect conversations, code, prompts, files, repo or branch names, credentials, model content, or per-turn activity timelines.
  • Wide terminals use a responsive, full-screen ocean canvas with modest gutters: prose keeps a readable measure while tools, diffs, work surfaces, the composer, and status chrome can use the available width. Turn and major activity seams breathe without padding every call inside a tool group.
  • Root CLI help describes product actions directly instead of exposing internal TUI/runtime layers.
  • Bash action="wait"

What's in v0.9.5

Codewhale v0.9.5 consolidates the terminal application into one compiled runtime while preserving the familiar codewhale and codew commands. It also expands the managed Runtime API, makes session and Fleet work easier to inspect and resume, and removes the hidden local continuation backstop that could end productive work without a final assistant response.

Added
  • model = "auto" for prompt-based tier selection: When set, the dispatcher analyses the user's prompt before delegating to the TUI and selects deepseek-v4-pro for complex tasks or deepseek-v4-flash for simple tasks (PR #5257).
  • Runtime API controls for persistent goals, bounded memory inspection, MCP server and skill lifecycle management, and durable Fleet receipt evidence.
  • Append-only session-tree history with /tree, /branch, /fork, and /resume, plus /rc remote control and managed login.
  • A unified Fleet roster for built-in dispatch postures and a pinned indicator that keeps active background work visible above the composer.
  • Incremental MCP registry refreshes that return the local snapshot immediately and update it in the background.
  • Scout and Reviewer agents can use a bounded direct-command evidence shell for read-only workspace, Git, and GitHub inspection, and can keep private working notes in their own To-do while the durable transcript retains their evidence.
Changed
  • codewhale-cli now contains the terminal runtime directly. Release installers expose byte-identical codewhale and codew commands without a separate TUI executable. The v0.9.5 asset set alone retains deprecated codewhale-tui-* filenames as byte-identical compatibility copies so installed v0.9.4 clients can discover and complete this upgrade.
  • Startup release checks cache successful lookups for one hour. The updater downloads and verifies the primary runtime once, then refreshes any existing codew or legacy codewhale-tui command paths from the same bytes.
  • Headless codewhale exec runs and verifier benchmark rollouts no longer impose a 100-step default. --max-turns remains available as an explicit opt-in ceiling; Fleet workers retain their separately configured budget.
  • Goal token and time budgets are telemetry rather than default stop conditions, and automatic goal continuation is unlimited unless the user explicitly configures a continuation ceiling.
  • Command-palette and slash-completion shadowing now share one alias-aware discovery contract.
  • The website install guidance, localized product copy, navigation controls, social metadata, and Cloudflare build pipeline now describe and deploy the same one-runtime release contract.
Fixed
  • The hidden 20-step no-user-input backstop no longer ends productive turns. Tool results, queued steering, child completions, REPL feedback, and goal continuations can all reach the next provider step and a final assistant response; explicit user-configured limits and genuine stuck-loop guards remain.
  • Complete error details are directly inspectable after a failure instead of leaving the terminal with a clipped, unrecoverable error fragment.
  • A newly minted OAuth credential is adopted in the same provider-selection flow instead of requiring a second picker trip.
  • Fresh session titles can replace a stale cached New Session placeholder, unknown model context limits fail loudly, and release/source-install fallbacks no longer request binaries removed by the single-runtime conversion.

What's in v0.9.4

Codewhale v0.9.4 ships the release-train harness work: the familiar Fleet roster/setup face with a clear operator-leader and user/folder scope, a work strip that keeps actionable agents instead of a permanent archive, waiting policy that forbids polling without freezing independent work, calmer tool output and session recovery, account/Workflow-search/ automation/handoff surfaces, a shorter translation-ready website, and release-blocker fixes across permissions, DeepSeek Responses, SQLite, File edits, terminal width, and Windows installation.

Added

  • Memory maintenance: remember gains revise and retire beside the default append. Both name the exact note they target and both require the evidence for the change. Append-only memory decays — a correction sits behind the note it contradicts and both keep reaching the model — so the model can now keep its own durable notes true instead of only adding to them.

  • An audit trail for durable state the model writes about you. Every in-place memory edit is journalled to memory/JOURNAL.md, and every continual-harness refine / remove to a JOURNAL.md beside its state, each with before, after, and evidence. Harness removal previously left no record at all even though the entry leaves state entirely, so the journal is now the only place its content survives.

  • A first-run tip that says so: the first time Codewhale saves something durable it points at /memory, translated into all fifteen complete locale packs. This state shaped later sessions and nothing ever mentioned it existed.

  • Sub-agent checkpoint resume: agents/followup resumes an interrupted_continuable child from its checkpoint into a fresh agent loop — new agent id, original prompt plus the prior conversation tail — when a runtime is attached, and otherwise keeps queue-only semantics with the continuation_handle returned; a second followup on the same interrupted id returns the existing resumed target instead of spawning a duplicate (PR #5242).

  • MCP Registry discovery with Registry-first tool selection: registry_sync surfaces the eligible local stdio catalog as a complete model-side candidate set, connect-failure messages classify early-exit and usage-help output and point recovery at the next Registry candidate, and a bundled mcp-discovery skill documents the flow (PR #5238).

  • Progressive fresh-context disclosure: fresh sessions ship a minimal constitutional kernel — ground truth, user intent and scope, truthful completion, guarantees in mechanism, and precedence — with procedural playbooks disclosed on demand, an opt-in project context pack (project_context_pack_enabled) counted in context reports, and load_skill catalogue discovery via name="list"; the measured fresh-context budget drops by roughly 40% (PR #5077).

  • Named Fleet store v2: one self-contained TOML Fleet per configuration (schema = "fleet"), with scope-explicit selection (user-global default vs folder override), migration receipts from legacy role profiles, and atomic saves that refuse to clobber a different Fleet on the same slug.

  • Scout replaces the user-facing "faster" control: catalog-verified fast siblings only, never a guessed model name; pinned Scout survives operator changes.

  • Truthful model-picker rows: vision/tools/limits chips only when the catalog knows, with provider → family → exact model grouping.

  • Opt-in product telemetry, off by default.

Recommended — npm (one command, all three entrypoints)
npm install -g codewhale

The wrapper downloads the matched codewhale, codew, and codewhale-tui binaries from this Release and places them in the same directory.

Docker / GHCR
docker run --rm -it \
  -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY" \

The image ships the codewhale dispatcher, codew shim, and codewhale-tui runtime. The latest tag is also updated on release.

Both crates are required — codewhale-cli produces the codewhale dispatcher and codew shim, while codewhale-tui produces the interactive runtime that the dispatcher delegates to. Installing only one crate will fail at runtime with a MISSING_COMPANION_BINARY error.

Platform Archive Install script

Linux ARM64 codewhale-linux-arm64.tar.gz install.sh
Android ARM64 (Termux) codewhale-android-arm64.tar.gz install.sh

Windows x64 codewhale-windows-x64.zip install.bat

cd codewhale-<platform>

sha256sum -c codewhale-bundles-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

# macOS
shasum -a 256 -c codewhale-bundles-sha256.txt --ignore-missing
shasum -a 256 -c codewhale-artifacts-sha256.txt --ignore-missing

What's in v0.9.2

This is the Codewhale v0.9.2 source candidate. It is not a published release until the matching tag, packages, checksums, and release assets exist.

Changed — behavior

  • Legacy model = auto no longer elects a network classifier on its own. Holding a DeepSeek API key used to silently select deepseek-v4-flash as the classifier for every Auto turn — a per-turn cost on a route nobody asked for, and one provider privileged over the rest. Auto now stays local and free unless an explicit [auto.router] block names a provider and model.

    If you relied on the implicit default, restore it explicitly:

    [auto.router]
provider = "deepseek"
model = "deepseek-v4-flash"

    [auto.router] remains legacy model = auto configuration. It is unrelated to a Fleet's Adaptive Reasoning Router, which is a saved service referenced by name from a Fleet file and decides only how hard an already-frozen route thinks.

Landed since v0.9.1, not yet released. A cluster of defects found by a read-through audit of the policy engine, the MCP proxy, the session index, and the app-server bridge — several of them cases where the wrong outcome was reached silently, behind a response or a log line that looked fine. The release also adds opt-in session, reasoning, localization, and inspectability surfaces; existing defaults remain stable unless an entry below explicitly says otherwise.

Added

  • /permissions now lists the active user permission-rule source, each rule's effective matcher and global/repository scope, and whether that scope applies in the current workspace. /permissions remove <number> previews deletion and requires a snapshot-bound confirmation token, so a concurrent edit cannot move a different rule under the confirmed index. Appends and removals share one adjacent lock, preserve unrelated TOML formatting and comments, atomically replace permissions.toml, and reload the live user ruleset without clearing session-only approvals. /config ask-rules remains a compatibility entry; rule creation, glob/directory rules, and deny persistence remain out of scope (#1186, PR #4960 by @greyfreedom).

  • /preview-request (aliases /dryrun and /preview_request) is a human-only, provider-free inspection of the next primary turn. Production dispatch and preview share one prepared-request seam across Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages, and OpenAI Responses, so the manifest reads the final wire model, reasoning controls, tool choice, tool schemas, and body hash from the same value production sends. Route, tool, or body facts that require Auto's provider classifier, an MCP connection, mutable hooks, compaction, or queued runtime injections remain typed unavailable. The manifest reports exact primary role/lane identity, upstream route-source provenance, requested and effective reasoning, canonical JSON sizes, conservative offline estimates, and provider-reported usage as unavailable because no request ran. It never adds a model-visible tool, sends a provider call, or prints prompt, message, credential, endpoint-path, or workspace-path content. The explicit /preview-request base-prompt

What's in v0.9.1
